translations.literal: Biographies 60: Loyalty and Righteousness II ○ Wu Sengge, Wugulun Desheng, Zhang Shun, Ma Xiang, Bode Wage, Aotun Chouheshang, Cong Tan, Beipailu Fushou, Wu Bangjie, Nahe Puladu, Nuxilie Wochu, Shi Maoxian, Wendihan Lao'er, Liang Chisheng, Jia Bangxian, Yila Alihe, Wanyan Liujin, Geshilie Heshou, Pucha Loushi, Nuxilie Zilu, Zhao Yi, Hou Xiaoshu, Wang Zuo, Huangguai Jiuzhu, Wulinda Qizhu, Tuoman Xielie, Nilanggupuluhu, Wuyan Weike, Wuyan Echuhu, Zhange Zhen

sentences.zh: 吳僧哥

translations.literal: Wu Sengge
translations.idiomatic: Wu Sengge

sentences.zh: 吳僧哥，西南路唐古乙剌颭上沙燕部落人。

translations.literal: Wu Sengge was a man of the Shayan tribal group at Tanggu Yilazhan on the Southwest Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Sengge came from the Shayan tribe at Tanggu Yilazhan on the Southwest Route.

sentences.zh: 拳勇善騎射。

translations.literal: He was bold in fists and skilled at mounted archery.
translations.idiomatic: He was powerfully built and an expert horseman and archer.

sentences.zh: 大安間，選籍山西人為兵，僧哥充馬軍千戶，有功。

translations.literal: During the Da'an era, men registered in Shanxi were selected for military service; Sengge served as commander of a cavalry thousand and rendered meritorious service.
translations.idiomatic: In the Da'an period, when Shanxi registrants were drafted into the army, Sengge was appointed commander of a cavalry thousand and distinguished himself.

sentences.zh: 貞祐初，遷萬戶，權順義軍節度使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Zhenyou era, he was promoted to wanhu and made acting Military Commissioner of the Shunyi Army.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Zhenyou he was promoted to wanhu and served as acting Military Commissioner of the Shunyi Army.

sentences.zh: 朔州失守，僧哥複取之，真授同知節度使事。

translations.literal: When Shuozhou was lost, Sengge recovered it and was then formally appointed Associate Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: After Shuozhou fell, Sengge retook it and received a formal appointment as associate military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 弟權同知節度使事迪剌真授節度副使。

translations.literal: His younger brother Dila, who had been acting associate military commissioner, was formally appointed deputy military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: His brother Dila, previously acting associate commissioner, was formally made deputy military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 權節度副使燕曹兒真授節度判官。

translations.literal: Yan Cao'er, acting deputy military commissioner, was formally appointed military commissioner judge.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Cao'er, who had served as acting deputy commissioner, received a formal appointment as military commissioner judge.

sentences.zh: 提控馬壽兒以下，遷授有差。

translations.literal: Detachment commanders Ma Shou'er and others below him received promotions of varying rank.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Shou'er and other detachment commanders under him were promoted at different levels.

sentences.zh: 眾苦乏食，僧哥乞賜糧十五萬斛。

translations.literal: The troops suffered from lack of food; Sengge requested a grant of 150,000 hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: With the men starving for provisions, Sengge asked for 150,000 hu of grain.

sentences.zh: 朝廷以為應州已破，朔為孤城，其勢不可守，乃遷朔之軍民九萬餘口分屯于嵐、石、隰、吉、絳、解之間。

translations.literal: The court considered that Yingzhou had already fallen and Shuozhou was an isolated city that could not be held, so it ordered the relocation of more than ninety thousand soldiers and civilians from Shuozhou, distributing them for garrison among Lan, Shi, Xi, Ji, Jiang, and Jie.
translations.idiomatic: Believing Yingzhou lost and Shuozhou indefensible as a lone stronghold, the court moved over ninety thousand troops and civilians southward, stationing them across Lan, Shi, Xi, Ji, Jiang, and Jie.

sentences.zh: 未行，大元兵至朔州，戰七晝夜，有功，加遙授同知太原府事、兼同知節度使事、迪剌石州刺史，曹兒同知岢嵐州防禦使事。

translations.literal: Before the move could be carried out, Great Yuan forces reached Shuozhou; they fought for seven days and nights with merit, and he was given the additional titles of remotely commissioned associate prefect of Taiyuan and concurrent associate military commissioner; Dila was made prefect of Shizhou, and Cao'er associate defense commissioner of Kelan.
translations.idiomatic: Before the evacuation began, Yuan armies besieged Shuozhou. After seven days and nights of fighting with distinction, Sengge was given an honorary post as associate prefect of Taiyuan and concurrent associate commissioner; Dila became prefect of Shizhou and Cao'er associate defense commissioner of Kelan.

sentences.zh: 四年，始遷其民南行，且戰且行者數十里，僧哥力憊馬躓死焉，時年三十。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the population at last was moved southward; fighting as they marched for several tens of li, Sengge, exhausted, died when his horse stumbled; he was thirty years old.
translations.idiomatic: In year four the people finally marched south. After fighting their way for dozens of li, Sengge, spent with effort, died when his horse fell; he was thirty.

sentences.zh: 詔贈鎮國上將軍、順義軍節度使。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously awarded him the rank of Defender-General of the State and Military Commissioner of the Shunyi Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously enfeoffed as Defender-General of the State and Military Commissioner of the Shunyi Army.

sentences.zh: 烏古論德升

translations.literal: Wugulun Desheng
translations.idiomatic: Wugulun Desheng

sentences.zh: 烏古論德升，本名六斤，益都路猛安人。

translations.literal: Wugulun Desheng, original name Liujin, was a meng'an of the Yidu Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Wugulun Desheng—born Liujin—was registered as a meng'an household on the Yidu Circuit.

sentences.zh: 明昌二年進士。

translations.literal: Jinshi graduate in the second year of Mingchang.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the second year of Mingchang.

sentences.zh: 累官補尚書省令史，知管差除。

translations.literal: Through successive posts he was appointed a clerical officer of the Secretariat and placed in charge of appointments and removals.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through offices, became a Secretariat clerical officer, and was put in charge of appointments.

sentences.zh: 除吏部主事、絳陽軍節度副使。

translations.literal: He was appointed a principal clerk in the Ministry of Personnel and deputy military commissioner of the Jiangyang Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was made principal clerk in the Ministry of Personnel and deputy military commissioner of the Jiangyang Army.

sentences.zh: 丁父憂，起複太常博士、東平治中。

translations.literal: Upon mourning his father's death he returned from leave as a doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and administrative aide of Dongping.
translations.idiomatic: After his father's mourning period he was recalled as a Court of Sacrifices doctor and Dongping administrative aide.

sentences.zh: 大安初，知弘文院。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Da'an he oversaw the Hongwen Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Da'an he was put in charge of the Hongwen Academy.

sentences.zh: 改侍御史，論西京留守紇石烈執中奸惡，衛紹王不聽，遷肇州防禦使。

translations.literal: Transferred to censor, he denounced the wickedness of Western Capital garrison commander Hesulie Zhizhong; Emperor Weishao did not heed him and transferred him to defense commissioner of Gaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Made supervising censor, he impeached Hesulie Zhizhong, Western Capital commander, for corruption; the Weishao Emperor ignored him and sent him to Gaozhou as defense commissioner.

sentences.zh: 宣宗遷汴，召赴闕，上言：「泰州殘破，東北路招討司猛安謀克人皆寓於肇州，凡徵調往復甚難。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xuanzong moved the capital to Bian, Desheng was summoned to court and memorialized: 'Taizhou lies in ruins; the meng'an and mouke households of the Northeast Route Pacification Commission are all lodged at Gaozhou, and every levy and dispatch is extremely difficult to carry out back and forth.'
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuanzong relocated to Bian, Desheng was called to court and submitted: 'Taizhou is devastated, and all the meng'an and mouke of the Northeast Route Pacification Commission are quartered at Gaozhou, so every levy and muster is painfully slow to execute.'

sentences.zh: 乞升肇州為節度使，以招討使兼之。

translations.literal: He asked that Gaozhou be elevated to a military commission and that the pacification commissioner hold the post concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that Gaozhou be raised to a military commission, with the pacification commissioner serving concurrently.

sentences.zh: 置招討副使二員，分治泰州及宜春。

translations.literal: He proposed appointing two deputy pacification commissioners to administer Taizhou and Yichun separately.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed two deputy pacification commissioners, one to govern Taizhou and one Yichun.

sentences.zh: 」詔從之。

translations.literal: An edict approved this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 進翰林侍讀學士、兼戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Hanlin Academician Reader-in-Waiting and concurrent Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Hanlin Reader-in-Waiting and concurrent Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 俄以翰林侍讀權參知政事，與平章政事抹撚盡忠論 近侍局預政，宣宗怒，語在《盡忠傳》。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter, as Hanlin Reader-in-Waiting he served as acting Councilor and, together with Grand Councilor Mozhan Jinzhong, argued against the Inner Service Bureau's participation in government; Emperor Xuanzong was angered—the account is in the Jinzhong biography.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, acting as Hanlin Reader-in-Waiting and Councilor, he joined Grand Councilor Mozhan Jinzhong in protesting the Inner Service Bureau's intrusion into government; Xuanzong was furious—the full story appears in Jinzhong's biography.

sentences.zh: 無何，出為集慶軍節度使，改汾陽軍節度使、河東北路宣撫副使，複改知太原府事、權元帥左監軍。

translations.literal: Before long he was sent out as Military Commissioner of the Jiqing Army, then transferred to Military Commissioner of the Fenyang Army and deputy pacification commissioner of the Hedong North Route; he was again changed to prefect of Taiyuan and acting Left Army Supervisor of the Marshalate.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was posted out as commissioner of the Jiqing Army, then made commissioner of the Fenyang Army and deputy pacification commissioner on the Hedong North Route, and finally reassigned as prefect of Taiyuan and acting Left Army Supervisor of the Marshalate.

sentences.zh: 興定元年，大元兵急攻太原，糧道絕。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xingding, Great Yuan forces pressed the attack on Taiyuan and the supply route was cut.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xingding, Yuan armies pressed hard on Taiyuan and cut off its supply lines.

sentences.zh: 德升屢出兵戰，糧道複通，詔遷官一階。

translations.literal: Desheng repeatedly led troops out to fight; the supply route was reopened, and an edict promoted him one rank.
translations.idiomatic: Desheng led repeated sorties; the supply route reopened, and he was promoted one rank by edict.

sentences.zh: 德升上言：「皇太子聰明仁孝、保訓之官已備，更宜選德望素著之士朝夕左右之。

translations.literal: Desheng memorialized: 'The Crown Prince is intelligent, benevolent, and filial, and his tutors are already in place; it would be better still to select men of long-standing virtue and reputation to attend him morning and evening.'
translations.idiomatic: Desheng wrote: 'The Crown Prince is intelligent, benevolent, and filial, and his tutors are already in place; men of proven virtue and standing should be chosen to attend him day and night.'

sentences.zh: 日聞正言、見正行，此社稷之洪休、生民之大慶也。

translations.literal: 'Hearing upright words daily and witnessing upright conduct—this would be a great blessing for the altars of state and a great rejoicing for the people.'
translations.idiomatic: 'To hear upright words every day and see upright conduct—this would be the state's greatest fortune and the people's greatest blessing.'

sentences.zh: 」宣宗嘉納之。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong commended and accepted this.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong praised and accepted the advice.

sentences.zh: 二年，真授左監軍，行元帥府事。

translations.literal: In the second year he was formally appointed Left Army Supervisor and directed the affairs of the Marshalate.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was formally made Left Army Supervisor and directed marshalate affairs.

sentences.zh: 大元兵複圍太原，環之數匝，已破濠垣，德升植柵為拒，出其家銀幣及馬賞戰士。

translations.literal: Great Yuan forces again besieged Taiyuan, encircling it several times; they had already breached the moat wall; Desheng planted palisades to resist and brought out his family's silver, cash, and horses to reward the warriors.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan armies again besieged Taiyuan, ringing the city round after round; they had already broken through the moat wall. Desheng threw up palisades to hold them off and distributed his family's silver, cash, and horses as rewards to the fighters.

sentences.zh: 北軍壞城西北隅以入，德升聯車塞之。

translations.literal: The northern army broke through the northwest corner of the wall to enter; Desheng chained wagons together to block it.
translations.idiomatic: The northern army breached the northwest corner of the wall; Desheng blocked the gap by chaining wagons together.

sentences.zh: 三卻三登，矢石如雨，守陴者不能立。

translations.literal: Three times they were driven back and three times they climbed up again; arrows and stones fell like rain, and those defending the parapets could not stand.
translations.idiomatic: Three times they were repulsed and three times they scaled the walls again; arrows and stones fell like rain, and the defenders on the battlements could not hold their ground.

sentences.zh: 城破，德升至府署，謂其姑及其妻曰：「吾守此數年，不幸力窮。

translations.literal: When the city fell, Desheng went to the government offices and said to his aunt and his wife: 'I have defended this place for several years, and unfortunately my strength is exhausted.'
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell, Desheng went to the government compound and told his aunt and wife: 'I have held this place for years, and now, alas, my strength is spent.'

sentences.zh: 」乃自縊而死。

translations.literal: He then hanged himself and died.
translations.idiomatic: He then hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 其姑及其妻皆自殺。

translations.literal: His aunt and his wife both killed themselves.
translations.idiomatic: His aunt and wife both took their own lives.

sentences.zh: 詔贈翰林學士承旨。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously awarded him Hanlin Academician Expositor.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Hanlin Academician Expositor.

sentences.zh: 子兀里偉尚幼，詔以奉禦俸養之。

translations.literal: His son Wuliwei was still young; an edict ordered that he be supported on a palace attendant's stipend.
translations.idiomatic: His son Wuliwei was still a child; an edict provided for his upkeep on a palace attendant's stipend.

sentences.zh: 張順，淄州士伍。

translations.literal: Zhang Shun was a common soldier of Zizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shun was a rank-and-file soldier of Zizhou.

sentences.zh: 淄州被圍，行省侯摯遣總領提控王庭玉將兵救之。

translations.literal: When Zizhou was besieged, Regional Commander Hou Zhi sent Chief Controller Wang Tingyu with troops to relieve it.
translations.idiomatic: When Zizhou came under siege, Regional Commander Hou Zhi sent Chief Controller Wang Tingyu with a relief force.

sentences.zh: 庭玉募順等三十人往覘兵勢，且欲令城中知援兵之至。

translations.literal: Tingyu recruited Shun and thirty others to go reconnoiter the enemy strength and also to let those in the city know that relief troops had arrived.
translations.idiomatic: Tingyu recruited Shun and thirty others to scout the enemy and to let the city know relief was near.

sentences.zh: 乘夜潛至城下，順為所得。

translations.literal: They stole to the foot of the city wall by night, and Shun was captured.
translations.idiomatic: They crept to the foot of the wall by night, and Shun was seized.

sentences.zh: 執之使宣言行省軍敗績，庭玉亦死，宜速降。

translations.literal: They seized him and made him proclaim that the regional army had been defeated, Tingyu was also dead, and they should surrender quickly.
translations.idiomatic: They seized him and forced him to announce that the regional army had been routed, Tingyu was dead, and the city should surrender at once.

sentences.zh: 順陽許諾，既乃呼謂城中曰：「外兵無多，王節度軍且至，堅守毋降！

translations.literal: Shun pretended to agree; then he called out to those in the city: 'There are not many troops outside; Commissioner Wang's army is about to arrive—hold firm and do not surrender!'
translations.idiomatic: Shun pretended to agree; then he shouted to the city: 'There are few troops outside; Commissioner Wang's army is almost here—hold firm and do not surrender!'

sentences.zh: 」兵刃交下，順曰：「得為忠孝鬼，足矣。

translations.literal: Weapons rained down on him; Shun said: 'To become a ghost of loyalty and filial piety is enough.'
translations.idiomatic: Blades rained down on him. Shun said: 'To die a ghost of loyalty and filial piety is enough.'

sentences.zh: 」遂死。

translations.literal: He then died.
translations.idiomatic: He died on the spot.

sentences.zh: 淄人知救兵至，以死守，城賴以完。

translations.literal: The people of Zi, knowing that relief troops had arrived, defended to the death, and the city was thereby preserved.
translations.idiomatic: Learning that relief had come, the people of Zi defended to the death, and the city was saved.

sentences.zh: 後贈宣武將軍、同知棣州防禦使事。

translations.literal: Later he was posthumously awarded General of Martial Proclamation and Associate Defense Commissioner of Dizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was later posthumously made General of Martial Proclamation and associate defense commissioner of Dizhou.

sentences.zh: 詔有司給養其親，且訪其子孫，優加任用。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the relevant offices to provide for his kin and also to seek out his descendants for preferential appointment.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the authorities to support his family and to seek out his descendants for preferential appointment.

sentences.zh: 馬驤，禹城人也。

translations.literal: Ma Xiang was a native of Yucheng.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xiang was from Yucheng.

sentences.zh: 登進士，曆官有聲。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination and won a reputation through successive offices.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi graduate, he earned a reputation in successive posts.

sentences.zh: 貞祐三年，為曹州濟陰令。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhenyou he was magistrate of Jiyin in Caozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhenyou he served as magistrate of Jiyin in Caozhou.

sentences.zh: 四月，大元克曹州，驤被執。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Great Yuan forces took Caozhou, and Xiang was captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the Yuan took Caozhou and Xiang was captured.

sentences.zh: 軍卒搒掠求金，驤曰：「吾書生，何從得是。

translations.literal: Soldiers beat and plundered him for gold; Xiang said: 'I am a scholar—where would I get such a thing?'
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers beat and robbed him for gold. Xiang said: 'I am a scholar—where would I get gold?'

sentences.zh: 」又使跪，驤曰：「吾膝不能屈，欲殺即殺，得死為大金鬼，足矣。

translations.literal: They also made him kneel; Xiang said: 'My knees cannot bend—if you wish to kill me, then kill me; to die and become a ghost of Great Jin is enough.'
translations.idiomatic: They ordered him to kneel. Xiang said: 'My knees do not bend—kill me if you will; to die and become a ghost of Great Jin is enough.'

sentences.zh: 」遂死。

translations.literal: He then died.
translations.idiomatic: He was killed.

sentences.zh: 贈朝列大夫、泰定軍節度副使，仍樹碑於州，歲時致祭。

translations.literal: He was posthumously awarded Grand Master of the Court and deputy military commissioner of the Taiding Army; a stele was also erected in the prefecture and sacrifices offered at the seasons.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Grand Master of the Court and deputy military commissioner of the Taiding Army; a stele was erected in the prefecture and seasonal sacrifices were offered.

sentences.zh: 貞祐四年七月，詔以其男惟賢于八貫石局分收補。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourth year of Zhenyou, an edict ordered that his son Weixian be enrolled for recruitment in the Baguan Shiju Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fourth year of Zhenyou, an edict enrolled his son Weixian for recruitment in the Baguan Shiju Bureau.

sentences.zh: 伯德窊哥

translations.literal: Bode Wage
translations.idiomatic: Bode Wage

sentences.zh: 奧屯醜和尚

translations.literal: Aotun Chouheshang
translations.idiomatic: Aotun Chouheshang

sentences.zh: 奧屯醜和尚，為代州經略使。

translations.literal: Aotun Chouheshang served as commissioner of frontier strategy for Daizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Aotun Chouheshang was frontier commissioner of Daizhou.

sentences.zh: 貞祐四年八月，大元兵攻代州，和尚禦戰敗績，身被數創，被執。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourth year of Zhenyou, Great Yuan forces attacked Daizhou; Chouheshang fought in defense but was defeated, suffered several wounds, and was captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year of Zhenyou, Yuan forces attacked Daizhou. Chouheshang fought but was defeated, took several wounds, and was captured.

sentences.zh: 欲降之，不屈，遂死。

translations.literal: They wished to make him surrender; he would not submit and died.
translations.idiomatic: They tried to make him surrender; he refused and was killed.

sentences.zh: 從坦，宗室子。

translations.literal: Cong Tan was a son of the imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: Cong Tan was a member of the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 大安中，充尚書省祗候郎君。

translations.literal: During Da'an he served as an attendant gentleman of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: During Da'an he served as a Secretariat attendant gentleman.

sentences.zh: 貞祐二年，自募義兵數千，充宣差都提控，詔從提舉奉先、范陽三都統兵。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenyou he personally recruited several thousand volunteer troops, served as imperial commissioner and chief controller, and was ordered to follow the three commanders-in-chief of Fengxian and Fanyang in raising troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhenyou he personally raised several thousand volunteers, was made imperial commissioner and chief controller, and was ordered to follow the three commanders-in-chief of Fengxian and Fanyang.

sentences.zh: 除同知涿州事，遷刺史，佩金牌，經略海州。

translations.literal: He was appointed associate prefect of Zhuozhou, then promoted to prefect, awarded a gold tablet, and made commissioner of strategy for Haizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was made associate prefect of Zhuozhou, then promoted to prefect, awarded a gold tablet, and put in charge of Haizhou.

sentences.zh: 頃之，充宣差都提控，安撫山西軍民，應援中都。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he served as imperial commissioner and chief controller, pacifying the soldiers and civilians of Shanxi and reinforcing Zhongdu.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he served as imperial commissioner and chief controller, pacifying Shanxi troops and civilians and reinforcing Zhongdu.

sentences.zh: 上書曰：「絳、解二州僅能城守，而村落之民皆嘗被兵，重以連歲不登，人多艱食，皆恃鹽布易米。

translations.literal: He memorialized: 'Jiang and Jie prefectures can barely hold their cities, while the villagers have all suffered warfare; added to this, harvests have failed for successive years and many lack food, all relying on salt and cloth to barter for grain.'
translations.idiomatic: He wrote: 'Jiang and Jie can barely hold their walls, while the countryside has all been ravaged by war. On top of years of failed harvests, many lack food and depend on trading salt and cloth for grain.'

sentences.zh: 今大陽等渡乃不許粟麥過河，願罷其禁，官稅十三，則公私皆濟矣。

translations.literal: 'Now the crossings at Dayang and elsewhere do not allow grain and wheat to cross the river; I ask that this prohibition be lifted and an official tax of one part in thirteen levied—then both public and private interests would be served.'
translations.idiomatic: 'At the Dayang crossings and elsewhere grain is forbidden to cross the river. Lift the ban and levy an official tax of one part in thirteen, and both state and people would benefit.'

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「絳、解、河中必爭之地，惟令寶昌軍節度使從宜規畫鹽池之利，以實二州，則民受其利，兵可以強矣。

translations.literal: He also said: 'Jiang, Jie, and Hezhong are ground that must be contested; only let the Military Commissioner of the Baochang Army plan the profits of the salt ponds as circumstances require to enrich the two prefectures—then the people would benefit and the army could be strengthened.'
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote: 'Jiang, Jie, and Hezhong are contested ground. Let the Baochang Army commissioner manage the salt ponds as circumstances allow to enrich the two prefectures—the people would profit and the army grow stronger.'

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「中條之南，垣曲、平陸、芮城、虞鄉，河東之形勢，陝、洛之襟喉也。

translations.literal: He also said: 'South of the Zhongtiao range—Yuanqu, Pinglu, Ruicheng, and Yuxiang—are the strategic terrain of Hedong and the throat of Shaan and Luo.'
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote: 'South of the Zhongtiao Mountains—Yuanqu, Pinglu, Ruicheng, and Yuxiang—are Hedong's strategic terrain and the gateway to Shaan and Luoyang.'

sentences.zh: 可分陝州步騎萬二千人為一提控、四都統，分戍四縣，此萬全之策也。

translations.literal: 'Twelve thousand infantry and cavalry from Shaanzhou could be divided into one chief controller and four commanders-in-chief to garrison the four counties separately—this would be a plan of complete security.'
translations.idiomatic: 'Divide twelve thousand infantry and cavalry from Shaanzhou into one chief controller and four commanders-in-chief to garrison the four counties—this would be a thoroughly secure plan.'

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「平陸產銀鐵，若以鹽易米，募工煉冶，可以廣財用、備戎器，小民傭力為食，可以息盜。

translations.literal: He also said: 'Pinglu produces silver and iron; if grain were exchanged for salt and workers recruited to smelt and refine, revenues could be expanded and weapons prepared; common people could be hired for wages and food, and banditry could be quelled.'
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote: 'Pinglu produces silver and iron. Trade salt for grain, hire workers to smelt and refine, and revenues would grow while arms were stocked; hire laborers for wages and food, and banditry would ease.'

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「河北貧民渡河逐食，已而複還濟其饑者，艱苦殊甚。

translations.literal: He also said: 'Poor people of Hebei cross the river in search of food and then return to relieve the hungry—their hardship is extreme.'
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote: 'Poor people of Hebei cross the river for food and return to feed the hungry at home—the hardship is extreme.'

sentences.zh: 苛暴之吏抑止誅求，弊莫大焉。

translations.literal: 'Harsh and violent officials suppress and extort them—the harm could not be greater.'
translations.idiomatic: 'Harsh officials suppress them and extort them—the harm could hardly be greater.'

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「河南、陝西調度未急，擇騎軍牝馬群牧，不二三年可增數萬騎，軍勢自振矣。

translations.literal: He also said: 'Supplies for Henan and Shaanxi are not yet urgent; select brood mares from the cavalry and herd them in groups—in less than two or three years several tens of thousands of mounts could be added and military strength would revive of itself.'
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote: 'Henan and Shaanxi are not yet in urgent need of supplies. Select brood mares from the cavalry and herd them in groups—in two or three years tens of thousands of mounts could be added and the army's strength would revive.'

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「諸路印造寶券，久而益多，必將積滯。

translations.literal: He also said: 'The various circuits print treasure notes, and as time passes they grow ever more numerous—they will inevitably pile up in stagnation.'
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote: 'The circuits print treasure notes, and over time they grow ever more numerous—they will inevitably pile up unused.'

sentences.zh: 止于南京印造給降，庶可久行。

translations.literal: 'If printing and distribution were limited to Nanjing, they could be kept in circulation for a long time.'
translations.idiomatic: 'Limit printing and distribution to Nanjing, and they could circulate for the long term.'

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「河北職任雖除授不次，而人皆不願者，蓋以物價十倍河南，祿廩不給，饑寒且至。

translations.literal: He also said: 'Although offices in Hebei are appointed out of turn, no one wishes to take them, because commodity prices are ten times those in Henan, salaries and grain rations do not suffice, and hunger and cold are at hand.'
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote: 'Although Hebei posts are filled out of turn, no one wants them, because prices are ten times those in Henan, salaries and grain rations fall short, and hunger and cold are near.'

sentences.zh: 若實給俸粟之半，少足養廉，則可責其效力。

translations.literal: 'If half their salary grain were actually paid out, enough at least to sustain integrity, then they could be required to perform effectively.'
translations.idiomatic: 'Pay half their salary grain in kind—enough at least to sustain integrity—and they could be held to perform.'

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「河北之官，朝廷減資遷秩躐等以答其勞。

translations.literal: He also said: 'Officials of Hebei—the court reduces their capital requirements for promotion and advances them by skipped ranks to reward their labors.'
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote: 'For Hebei officials the court lowers capital requirements for promotion and advances them by skipped ranks to reward their service.'

sentences.zh: 聞河南官吏以貶逐目之，彼若以為信然，誰不解體？

translations.literal: 'I hear that officials of Henan regard them as demoted and banished; if those men take that to be true, who would not lose heart?'
translations.idiomatic: 'I hear Henan officials treat them as demoted and banished. If they believe it, who would not lose heart?'

sentences.zh: 」書奏，下尚書省議，惟許放大陽等渡、宣撫司量民力給河北官俸、目河北為貶所者有禁而已。

translations.literal: When the memorial was submitted, it was sent down to the Secretariat for deliberation; only opening the Dayang crossings, having the Pacification Commission measure popular strength in paying Hebei officials' salaries, and forbidding those who regarded Hebei as a place of demotion were approved.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was submitted, the Secretariat deliberated and approved only opening the Dayang crossings, having the Pacification Commission pay Hebei officials according to local capacity, and forbidding the treatment of Hebei as a place of demotion.

sentences.zh: 四年，行樞密院于河南府，上書曰：「用兵累年，出輒無功者，兵不素勵也。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he directed the Bureau of Military Affairs at Henan Prefecture and memorialized: 'War has been waged for many years, yet every campaign ends without success because the troops have not been trained over time.'
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he directed the Bureau of Military Affairs at Henan Prefecture and wrote: 'War has dragged on for years, yet every campaign fails because the troops have not been trained over time.'

sentences.zh: 士庶且充行伍，況于皇族與國同休戚哉。

translations.literal: 'Commoners and gentry already fill the ranks—how much more should the imperial clan, who share weal and woe with the state!'
translations.idiomatic: 'Commoners and gentry already fill the ranks—how much more should the imperial clan, who share the state's weal and woe!'

sentences.zh: 皆當從軍，親冒矢石，為士卒先，少寬聖主之憂。

translations.literal: 'All should take the field, personally braving arrows and stones and leading the soldiers as their vanguard, to ease somewhat the sage ruler's anxieties.'
translations.idiomatic: 'All should take the field, face arrows and stones in person, and lead the troops as their vanguard, to ease the sage ruler's anxieties somewhat.'

sentences.zh: 族人道哥實同此心，願隸臣麾下。

translations.literal: 'My clansman Daoge truly shares this heart and wishes to be placed under my command.'
translations.idiomatic: 'My clansman Daoge shares this resolve and asks to serve under my command.'

sentences.zh: 」宣宗嘉其忠，許之。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong commended his loyalty and granted this.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong praised his loyalty and approved.

sentences.zh: 當是時，諸路兵皆入城自守，百姓耕稼失所，從坦上書曰：「養兵所以衛民。

translations.literal: At this time the armies of all circuits had entered the cities to defend themselves, and the people lost their fields in planting and harvest; Cong Tan memorialized: 'Armies are maintained in order to protect the people.'
translations.idiomatic: At that time armies everywhere had withdrawn into the cities, and farmers lost their planting and harvest seasons. Cong Tan wrote: 'Armies are raised to protect the people.'

sentences.zh: 方今河朔惟真定、河間之眾可留捍城，其餘府州皆當散屯於外，以為民防，俟稼穡畢功然後移於屯守之地，是為長策。

translations.literal: 'At present in Hebei only the forces of Zhending and Hejian can be kept to defend the cities; all other prefectures and subprefectures should be posted in scattered camps outside as protection for the people, and only after the harvest is finished should they move to their garrison posts—this would be the long-term plan.'
translations.idiomatic: 'In Hebei today only the troops of Zhending and Hejian should remain to hold the walls; other prefectures should camp in scattered posts outside to shield the people, and only after the harvest should they move to their garrison stations—this is the long-term plan.'

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 加遙授同知東平府事，權元帥左監軍、行元帥府事，與參知政事李革俱守平陽。

translations.literal: He was given the additional title of remotely commissioned associate prefect of Dongping, acting Left Army Supervisor and director of marshalate affairs, and together with Councilor Li Ge defended Pingyang.
translations.idiomatic: He was given an honorary post as associate prefect of Dongping, made acting Left Army Supervisor and director of marshalate affairs, and together with Councilor Li Ge defended Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 興定二年十月，從坦上奏：「太原已破，行及平陽。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the second year of Xingding, Cong Tan memorialized: 'Taiyuan has already fallen, and the enemy is advancing on Pingyang.'
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the second year of Xingding, Cong Tan reported: 'Taiyuan has fallen, and the enemy is advancing on Pingyang.'

sentences.zh: 河東郡縣皆不守，大抵屯兵少、援兵不至故耳。

translations.literal: The prefectures and counties of Hedong all failed to hold, for the most part because garrison troops were few and relief troops did not arrive.
translations.idiomatic: The prefectures and counties of Hedong all fell, mostly because garrisons were too thin and relief never came.

sentences.zh: 行省兵不滿六千。

translations.literal: The regional army numbered fewer than six thousand.
translations.idiomatic: The regional army had fewer than six thousand men.

sentences.zh: 平陽，河東之根本，河南之籓籬也。

translations.literal: Pingyang is the root of Hedong and the outer rampart of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Pingyang is the foundation of Hedong and the outer rampart of Henan.

sentences.zh: 乞並懷、孟、衛州之兵以實潞州，調澤州、沁水、端氏、高平諸兵並山為營，為平陽聲援。

translations.literal: He asked that the troops of Huai, Meng, and Weizhou be combined to strengthen Luzhou, and that the forces of Zezhou, Qinshui, Duanshi, and Gaoping be deployed in camps along the mountains as a supporting voice for Pingyang.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that troops from Huai, Meng, and Weizhou be combined to reinforce Luzhou, and that forces from Zezhou, Qinshui, Duanshi, and Gaoping be posted in mountain camps to support Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 惟祈聖斷，以救倒懸之急。

translations.literal: He prayed only for the sage ruler's decision to rescue this crisis of hanging upside down.
translations.idiomatic: He begged only for the emperor's decision to relieve this desperate crisis.

sentences.zh: 」是月壬子，大元兵至平陽，提控郭用戰於城北濠垣，被執不屈而死。

translations.literal: In that month on the day renzi, Great Yuan forces reached Pingyang; Detachment Controller Guo Yong fought at the moat wall north of the city, was captured, would not submit, and died.
translations.idiomatic: That month on the day renzi, Yuan forces reached Pingyang. Detachment Controller Guo Yong fought at the northern moat, was captured, refused to submit, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，城破，從坦自殺。

translations.literal: On guichou the city fell and Cong Tan killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou the city fell and Cong Tan took his own life.

sentences.zh: 贈昌武軍節度使。

translations.literal: He was posthumously awarded Military Commissioner of the Changwu Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Military Commissioner of the Changwu Army.

sentences.zh: 孛朮魯福壽

translations.literal: Beipailu Fushou
translations.idiomatic: Beipailu Fushou

sentences.zh: 孛朮魯福壽，為唐邑主簿。

translations.literal: Beipailu Fushou served as chief clerk of Tangyi.
translations.idiomatic: Beipailu Fushou was chief clerk of Tangyi.

sentences.zh: 大元兵攻唐邑，福壽與戰，死之。

translations.literal: When Great Yuan forces attacked Tangyi, Fushou fought and died.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan forces attacked Tangyi, Fushou fought and was killed.

sentences.zh: 贈官三階，賻錢五百貫。

translations.literal: He was posthumously promoted three ranks and given five hundred strings of burial money.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously promoted three ranks and granted five hundred strings for burial expenses.

sentences.zh: 吳邦傑

translations.literal: Wu Bangjie
translations.idiomatic: Wu Bangjie

sentences.zh: 吳邦傑，登州軍事判官。

translations.literal: Wu Bangjie was military judge of Dengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Bangjie was military judge of Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 邦傑寓居日照之村墅，為大元兵所得，驅令攻城，邦傑曰：「吾荷吾國恩，詎忍攻吾君之城。

translations.literal: Bangjie was lodging in a village estate at Rizhao when he was seized by Great Yuan troops; they drove him to attack the city, and Bangjie said: 'I have received my state's grace—how could I bear to attack my ruler's city?'
translations.idiomatic: Bangjie was staying at a village estate near Rizhao when Yuan troops seized him and forced him to attack the city. He said: 'I owe my state a debt of grace—how could I bear to attack my ruler's city?'

sentences.zh: 」與之酒食不顧，乃殺之。

translations.literal: They offered him wine and food but he paid no heed, and they killed him.
translations.idiomatic: They offered him food and wine, but he refused, and they killed him.

sentences.zh: 詔贈朝列大夫、定海軍節度副使。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously awarded him Grand Master of the Court and deputy military commissioner of the Dinghai Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Grand Master of the Court and deputy military commissioner of the Dinghai Army.

sentences.zh: 納合蒲剌都

translations.literal: Nahe Puladu
translations.idiomatic: Nahe Puladu

sentences.zh: 納合蒲剌都，大名路猛安人。

translations.literal: Nahe Puladu was a meng'an of the Daming Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Nahe Puladu was registered as a meng'an household on the Daming Circuit.

sentences.zh: 承安二年進士，調大名教授。

translations.literal: Jinshi graduate in the second year of Chengan; he was assigned as instructor at Daming.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi graduate in the second year of Chengan, he was posted as instructor at Daming.

sentences.zh: 累除比陽令，補尚書省令史，除彰德軍節度副使，以憂去官。

translations.literal: Through successive appointments he was made magistrate of Biyang, supplemented as a Secretariat clerical officer, appointed deputy military commissioner of the Zhangde Army, and left office on account of mourning.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through posts as magistrate of Biyang, Secretariat clerical officer, and deputy military commissioner of the Zhangde Army, then left office to mourn.

sentences.zh: 貞祐二年，調同知西安軍節度使事，曆同知臨洮、平涼府事，河州防禦使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenyou he was transferred to associate military commissioner of the Xi'an Army, then served successively as associate prefect of Linzhou and Pingliang and as defense commissioner of Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhenyou he was made associate military commissioner of the Xi'an Army, then served as associate prefect of Linzhou and Pingliang and as defense commissioner of Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 三年，夏人圍定羌，蒲剌都擊走之，以功加遙授彰化軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the third year the Xia besieged Dingqiang; Puladu drove them off and, for his merit, was given the additional title of remotely commissioned Military Commissioner of the Zhanghua Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year the Xia besieged Dingqiang; Puladu repulsed them and was given an honorary post as military commissioner of the Zhanghua Army.

sentences.zh: 四年，升河州為平西軍，就以蒲剌都為節度使。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Hezhou was elevated to the Pingxi Army, and Puladu was made its military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Hezhou was raised to the Pingxi Army, and Puladu was made its military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 上言：「古者一人從軍，七家奉之，興十萬之師，不得操事者七十萬家。

translations.literal: He memorialized: 'In antiquity when one man joined the army, seven households supported him; to raise an army of one hundred thousand, seven hundred thousand households could not attend to their work.'
translations.idiomatic: He wrote: 'In antiquity one soldier on campaign was supported by seven households; to raise an army of one hundred thousand left seven hundred thousand households unable to tend their fields.'

sentences.zh: 今籍諸道民為兵者十之七八，奉之者才二三，民安得不困。

translations.literal: 'Today seven or eight tenths of the people on the various circuits are registered as soldiers, while only two or three tenths support them—how could the people not be distressed?'
translations.idiomatic: 'Today seven or eight in ten people on the circuits are registered as soldiers, while only two or three in ten support them—how could the people not be exhausted?'

sentences.zh: 夫兵貴精，不在眾寡。

translations.literal: 'What troops value is quality, not whether they are many or few.'
translations.idiomatic: 'Troops are valued for quality, not numbers.'

sentences.zh: 擇勇敢謀略者為兵，脆懦之徒使歸農畝，是亦紓民之一端也。

translations.literal: 'Choose the brave and resourceful for the army and send the frail and cowardly back to the fields—this too would be one way to ease the people's burden.'
translations.idiomatic: 'Choose the brave and resourceful for the army and send the weak and timid back to the fields—this too would ease the people's burden.'

sentences.zh: 」又請補官贖罪以足用，及請許人射佃陝西荒田、開採礦冶，不報。

translations.literal: He also asked that offices be sold to redeem crimes in order to fill the treasury, and that people be allowed to lease and cultivate wasteland in Shaanxi and open mines and smelters—the court gave no reply.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked to sell offices for crime redemption to fill the treasury, and to allow people to lease wasteland in Shaanxi and open mines—the court did not respond.

sentences.zh: 改知平涼府事，入為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: He was changed to prefect of Pingliang and entered the capital as Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was made prefect of Pingliang, then entered the capital as Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 是時，伐宋大捷，蒲剌都奏：「宋人屢敗，其氣必沮，可乘此遣人諭說，以尋舊盟。

translations.literal: At this time a great victory was won over Song; Puladu memorialized: 'The Song have been defeated repeatedly and their spirit must be crushed; we could take advantage of this to send envoys to persuade them and seek the old alliance.'
translations.idiomatic: At that time a great victory was won over Song. Puladu wrote: 'The Song have been defeated again and again and their spirit must be broken; we should seize this moment to send envoys to negotiate and renew the old alliance.'

sentences.zh: 若宋人不從，然後伐之，疾仇怒頑，易以成功。

translations.literal: 'If the Song do not comply, then attack them afterward; swift vengeance against stubborn foes is easy to bring to success.'
translations.idiomatic: 'If the Song refuse, then attack them; swift vengeance against stubborn foes is easier to bring off.'

sentences.zh: 」朝廷不能用。

translations.literal: The court could not adopt this.
translations.idiomatic: The court did not adopt the proposal.

sentences.zh: 蒲剌都又言：「諸軍當汰去老弱，妙選精銳，庶可取勝。

translations.literal: Puladu also said: 'The various armies should weed out the old and weak and finely select elite troops—then victory might be won.'
translations.idiomatic: Puladu also wrote: 'The armies should weed out the old and weak and select elite troops—only then can victory be won.'

sentences.zh: 陝西弓箭手不習騎射，可選善騎者代之。

translations.literal: 'The archers of Shaanxi are not practiced in mounted shooting; skilled horsemen could be chosen to replace them.'
translations.idiomatic: 'Shaanxi archers are not trained in mounted archery; skilled horsemen should replace them.'

sentences.zh: 延安屯兵甚眾，分徙萬人駐平涼。

translations.literal: 'The garrison at Yan'an is very large; ten thousand could be moved to station at Pingliang.'
translations.idiomatic: 'The garrison at Yan'an is very large; ten thousand men could be moved to Pingliang.'

sentences.zh: 關中元帥猥多，除京兆重鎮，其餘皆可罷。

translations.literal: 'Marshals in Guanzhong are excessively numerous; except for the key post at Jingzhao, the rest could all be abolished.'
translations.idiomatic: 'There are too many marshals in Guanzhong; except for the key post at Jingzhao, the rest should be abolished.'

sentences.zh: 鞏縣以北，黃河南岸，及金鉤、吊橋、虎牢關、虢州崿嶺，凡斜徑僻路俱當置兵防守。

translations.literal: 'North of Gongxian, on the south bank of the Yellow River, and at Jingou, Diaobridge, Hulaoguan, and the Eling of Guozhou—all oblique paths and secluded roads should have troops posted for defense.'
translations.idiomatic: 'North of Gongxian, on the south bank of the Yellow River, and at Jingou, Diaobridge, Hulaoguan, and the Eling of Guozhou—all side paths and hidden routes should be garrisoned.'

sentences.zh: 」詔下尚書省、樞密院議，竟不施行。

translations.literal: An edict sent the proposal down to the Secretariat and Bureau of Military Affairs for deliberation, but in the end it was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was sent to the Secretariat and Bureau of Military Affairs for deliberation, but in the end it was not implemented.

sentences.zh: 未幾，改元帥右監軍、兼昭義軍節度使、行元帥府事。

translations.literal: Before long he was changed to Right Army Supervisor of the Marshalate, concurrent Military Commissioner of the Zhaoyi Army, and director of marshalate affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was made Right Army Supervisor of the Marshalate, concurrent military commissioner of the Zhaoyi Army, and director of marshalate affairs.

sentences.zh: 興定二年，潞州破，力戰而死。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xingding Luzhou fell; he fought fiercely and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xingding Luzhou fell; he fought to the end and was killed.

sentences.zh: 贈御史大夫。

translations.literal: He was posthumously awarded Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 女奚烈斡出

translations.literal: Nuxilie Wochu
translations.idiomatic: Nuxilie Wochu

sentences.zh: 女奚烈斡出，仕至楨州刺史，被行省牒徙州人于金勝堡。

translations.literal: Nuxilie Wochu rose in office to prefect of Zhenzhou; he received a regional order to move the people of the prefecture to Jinsheng Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Nuxilie Wochu rose to prefect of Zhenzhou and received a regional order to relocate the prefecture's people to Jinsheng Fort.

sentences.zh: 已而大兵至，斡出拒戰，中流矢，病創臥。

translations.literal: Before long the main army arrived; Wochu resisted in battle, was struck by a stray arrow, and lay ill from his wound.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the main army arrived. Wochu fought back, was struck by an arrow, and lay wounded in bed.

sentences.zh: 花帽軍張提控言：「兵勢不可當，宜速降。

translations.literal: Zhang, detachment controller of the Flower-Cap Army, said: 'The enemy force cannot be withstood—we should surrender quickly.'
translations.idiomatic: Zhang, detachment controller of the Flower-Cap Army, said: 'The enemy cannot be withstood—we should surrender at once.'

sentences.zh: 」斡出曰：「吾曹坐食官祿，可忘國家恩乎。

translations.literal: Wochu said: 'We sit and eat official stipends—can we forget the state's grace?'
translations.idiomatic: Wochu said: 'We live on official stipends—can we forget the state's grace?'

sentences.zh: 汝不聞趙坊州乎，以金帛子女與敵人，終亦不免。

translations.literal: 'Have you not heard of Zhao of Fangzhou? He gave gold, silk, and women to the enemy, yet in the end could not escape.'
translations.idiomatic: 'Have you not heard of Zhao of Fangzhou? He gave gold, silk, and women to the enemy, yet could not escape in the end.'

sentences.zh: 我輩但當力戰而死耳。

translations.literal: 'We should only fight to the death.'
translations.idiomatic: 'We should only fight to the death.'

sentences.zh: 」至夜，張提控引數人持兵仗以入，脅斡出使出降，斡出曰：「聽汝所為，吾終不屈也。

translations.literal: By night Zhang the detachment controller led several men bearing weapons inside and forced Wochu to come out and surrender; Wochu said: 'Do as you will—I will never submit.'
translations.idiomatic: That night Zhang led several armed men inside and forced Wochu to surrender. Wochu said: 'Do as you will—I will never submit.'

sentences.zh: 」遂殺之，執其妻子出降。

translations.literal: They then killed him and took his wife and children out to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: They killed him and took his wife and children out to surrender.

sentences.zh: 初，楨州人遷金勝堡多不能至，軍事判官王謹收遺散之眾，別屯周安堡。

translations.literal: Earlier, many of the people of Zhenzhou relocated to Jinsheng Fort could not reach it; Military Judge Wang Jin gathered the scattered survivors and encamped separately at Zhou'an Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, many people of Zhenzhou bound for Jinsheng Fort could not reach it. Military Judge Wang Jin gathered the scattered survivors and encamped separately at Zhou'an Fort.

sentences.zh: 周安堡不繕完樓堞、置戰守之具，兵至，謹拒戰十餘日，內潰，被執不屈而死。

translations.literal: Zhou'an Fort had not been repaired with complete parapets or equipped for defense; when troops arrived, Jin resisted for more than ten days, the garrison collapsed from within, he was captured, would not submit, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou'an Fort had not been repaired or equipped for defense. When troops arrived, Jin resisted for more than ten days until the garrison collapsed from within; he was captured, refused to submit, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 詔斡出、謹各贈官六階、升職三等。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously awarded Wochu and Jin each six ranks of promotion and three grades of advancement in office.
translations.idiomatic: Wochu and Jin were each posthumously promoted six ranks and advanced three grades in office.

sentences.zh: 時茂先

translations.literal: Shi Maoxian
translations.idiomatic: Shi Maoxian

sentences.zh: 時茂先，日照縣沙溝酒監，寓居諸城。

translations.literal: Shi Maoxian was wine supervisor of Shagou in Rizhao County and was lodging in Zhucheng.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Maoxian was wine supervisor of Shagou in Rizhao County and was staying in Zhucheng.

sentences.zh: 紅襖賊方郭三據密州，過其村，居民相率迎之。

translations.literal: The Red-Jacket bandit Fang Guo San held Mizhou; passing his village, the residents went out together to welcome him.
translations.idiomatic: The Red-Jacket bandit Fang Guo San held Mizhou. Passing Maoxian's village, the residents went out together to welcome him.

sentences.zh: 賊以元帥自稱，茂先怒謂眾曰：「此賊首耳，何元帥之有。

translations.literal: The bandit styled himself marshal; Maoxian angrily told the crowd: 'This is merely a bandit chief—what marshal is there?'
translations.idiomatic: The bandit styled himself marshal. Maoxian angrily told the crowd: 'He is only a bandit chief—what marshal is there?'

sentences.zh: 」方郭三聞而執之，斷其腕，茂先大罵，賊不勝忿，複剔其目，亂刃剉之，至死罵不絕。

translations.literal: Fang Guo San heard this and seized him, severed his wrist; Maoxian cursed loudly; the bandits, unable to contain their rage, gouged out his eyes and hacked him with blades in disorder; to his death his curses did not cease.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Guo San heard this and seized him, severing his wrist. Maoxian cursed loudly. Unable to contain their rage, the bandits gouged out his eyes and hacked him to pieces; he cursed without ceasing until he died.

sentences.zh: 詔贈武節將軍、同知沂州防禦使事。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously awarded him General of Martial Integrity and Associate Defense Commissioner of Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made General of Martial Integrity and associate defense commissioner of Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 溫蒂罕老兒

translations.literal: Wendihan Lao'er
translations.idiomatic: Wendihan Lao'er

sentences.zh: 溫蒂罕老兒，為同知上京留守事。

translations.literal: Wendihan Lao'er served as associate commissioner of the Shangjing garrison headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Wendihan Lao'er was associate commissioner of the Shangjing garrison headquarters.

sentences.zh: 蒲鮮萬奴攻上京，其子鐵哥生獲老兒，脅之使招餘人，不從。

translations.literal: Puxian Wannu attacked Shangjing; his son Tiege captured Lao'er alive and coerced him to summon the others; he would not comply.
translations.idiomatic: Puxian Wannu attacked Shangjing. His son Tiege captured Lao'er alive and tried to force him to summon the others; he refused.

sentences.zh: 鐵哥怒，亂斫而死。

translations.literal: Tiege was enraged and hacked him to death in disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Tiege flew into a rage and hacked him to death.

sentences.zh: 贈龍虎衛上將軍、婆速兵馬都總管，以其侄黑廝為後，特授四官。

translations.literal: He was posthumously awarded General of the Dragon-Tiger Guard and Commander-in-Chief of Basu Troops and Horses; his nephew Heisi was made his heir and specially granted four offices.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made General of the Dragon-Tiger Guard and commander-in-chief of Basu troops and horses; his nephew Heisi was made his heir and specially granted four offices.

sentences.zh: 梁持勝

translations.literal: Liang Chisheng
translations.idiomatic: Liang Chisheng

sentences.zh: 梁持勝，字經甫，本名詢誼，避宣宗嫌名改焉。

translations.literal: Liang Chisheng, style name Jingfu, original name Xunyi, changed to avoid the taboo name of Emperor Xuanzong.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Chisheng, style name Jingfu, was born Xunyi and changed his name to avoid Emperor Xuanzong's taboo.

sentences.zh: 保大軍節度使襄之子。

translations.literal: He was the son of Xiang, Military Commissioner of the Baoda Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was the son of Xiang, military commissioner of the Baoda Army.

sentences.zh: 多力善射。

translations.literal: He was very strong and skilled at archery.
translations.idiomatic: He was powerfully built and an expert archer.

sentences.zh: 泰和六年進士，複中宏詞。

translations.literal: Jinshi graduate in the sixth year of Taihe; he also passed the macro-phrase examination.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi graduate in the sixth year of Taihe, he also passed the macro-phrase examination.

sentences.zh: 累官太常博士，遷咸平路宣撫司經歷官。

translations.literal: Through successive offices he became a doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and was transferred to administrative aide of the Xianping Circuit Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to doctor of the Court of Sacrifices and was made administrative aide of the Xianping Circuit Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 興定初，宣撫使蒲鮮萬奴有異志，欲棄咸平徙曷懶路，持勝力止之，萬奴怒，杖之八十。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xingding the Pacification Commissioner Puxian Wannu harbored a different intent and wished to abandon Xianping and move to the Yilan Route; Chisheng strenuously stopped him; Wannu was angry and had him beaten eighty strokes.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Xingding, Pacification Commissioner Puxian Wannu harbored disloyal ambitions and wished to abandon Xianping for the Yilan Route. Chisheng strenuously opposed him; Wannu was furious and had him beaten eighty strokes.

sentences.zh: 持勝走上京，告行省太平。

translations.literal: Chisheng fled to Shangjing and reported this to Regional Commander Taiping.
translations.idiomatic: Chisheng fled to Shangjing and reported the matter to Regional Commander Taiping.

sentences.zh: 是時，太平已與萬奴通謀，口稱持勝忠，而心實不然，署持勝左右司員外郎。

translations.literal: At this time Taiping had already conspired with Wannu; he praised Chisheng's loyalty in words but in his heart did not mean it, and appointed Chisheng Left and Right Secretariat Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: By then Taiping had already conspired with Wannu. He praised Chisheng's loyalty in words but did not mean it, and appointed him Left and Right Secretariat Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 既而太平受萬奴命，焚毀上京宗廟，執元帥承充，奪其軍。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter Taiping, acting on Wannu's orders, burned the ancestral temples of Shangjing, seized Marshal Chengchong, and took his army.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Taiping, acting on Wannu's orders, burned the ancestral temples of Shangjing, seized Marshal Chengchong, and took his army.

sentences.zh: 持勝與提控咸平治中裴滿賽不、萬戶韓公恕約，殺太平，複推承充行省事，共伐萬奴。

translations.literal: Chisheng joined Detachment Controller and Xianping Administrative Aide Puman Saibu and Wanhu Han Gongshu in a pact to kill Taiping, restore Chengchong to direct regional affairs, and together attack Wannu.
translations.idiomatic: Chisheng joined Detachment Controller and Xianping Administrative Aide Puman Saibu and Wanhu Han Gongshu in a plot to kill Taiping, restore Chengchong to direct regional affairs, and attack Wannu together.

sentences.zh: 事泄，俱被害。

translations.literal: The affair was exposed and all were killed.
translations.idiomatic: The plot was exposed and all were killed.

sentences.zh: 詔贈持勝中順大夫、韓州刺史，賽不鎮國上將軍、顯德軍節度使，公恕明威將軍、信州刺史。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously awarded Chisheng Grand Master of Central Accordance and Prefect of Hanzhou, Saibu Defender-General of the State and Military Commissioner of the Xiande Army, and Gongshu General of Bright Authority and Prefect of Xinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Chisheng was posthumously made Grand Master of Central Accordance and prefect of Hanzhou; Saibu was made Defender-General of the State and military commissioner of the Xiande Army; Gongshu was made General of Bright Authority and prefect of Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 賈邦獻

translations.literal: Jia Bangxian
translations.idiomatic: Jia Bangxian

sentences.zh: 賈邦獻，霍州霍邑縣陳村人也。

translations.literal: Jia Bangxian was a native of Chen Village in Huoyi County, Huozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Bangxian was from Chen Village in Huoyi County, Huozhou.

sentences.zh: 舉進士第。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 質直有勇略。

translations.literal: He was upright by nature and possessed courage and strategy.
translations.idiomatic: He was upright by nature and possessed courage and strategic sense.

sentences.zh: 大元攻河東，邦獻集居民為守禦計。

translations.literal: When Great Yuan forces attacked Hedong, Bangxian gathered the residents to plan defense.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan forces attacked Hedong, Bangxian gathered the residents to organize a defense.

sentences.zh: 既而，兵大至，居民悉降。

translations.literal: Before long the army arrived in force and the residents all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Before long a large army arrived and the residents all surrendered.

sentences.zh: 邦獻棄其家，獨與子懿保于松平寨。

translations.literal: Bangxian abandoned his household and alone with his son Yi took refuge at Songping Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Bangxian abandoned his household and alone with his son Yi took refuge at Songping Stockade.

sentences.zh: 是時，權知州事劉珍在寨，與之共守，竟能成功。

translations.literal: At this time Liu Zhen, acting prefect, was at the stockade; together they defended it and in the end succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Liu Zhen, acting prefect, was at the stockade; together they held it and succeeded in the end.

sentences.zh: 珍每欲辟之，邦獻輒以衰老為辭。

translations.literal: Whenever Zhen wished to recruit him, Bangxian declined on the grounds of old age.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever Zhen wished to recruit him, Bangxian declined on grounds of old age.

sentences.zh: 興定四年十月，兵複大至，病不能避，與懿俱被執。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fourth year of Xingding the army came again in force; ill and unable to escape, he and Yi were both captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fourth year of Xingding the army came again in force. Too ill to escape, he and Yi were both captured.

sentences.zh: 欲以為鎮西元帥，且持刃脅之，邦獻不屈，密遣懿歸松平，遂自剄。

translations.literal: They wished to make him Marshal of the West and moreover threatened him with blades; Bangxian would not submit, secretly sent Yi back to Songping, and then cut his own throat.
translations.idiomatic: They wished to make him Marshal of the West and threatened him with blades. Bangxian refused, secretly sent Yi back to Songping, and cut his own throat.

sentences.zh: 贈奉直大夫、本縣令。

translations.literal: He was posthumously awarded Grand Master of Direct Service and Magistrate of his home county.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Grand Master of Direct Service and magistrate of his home county.

sentences.zh: 移剌阿里合

translations.literal: Yila Alihe
translations.idiomatic: Yila Alihe

sentences.zh: 移剌阿里合，遼人。

translations.literal: Yila Alihe was a man of Liao.
translations.idiomatic: Yila Alihe was a man of Liao descent.

sentences.zh: 興定間，累遷霍州刺史。

translations.literal: During Xingding he was repeatedly promoted to prefect of Huozhou.
translations.idiomatic: During Xingding he rose to prefect of Huozhou.

sentences.zh: 興定四年正月，移霍州治好義堡。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year of Xingding the seat of Huozhou was moved to Haoyi Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year of Xingding the seat of Huozhou was moved to Haoyi Fort.

sentences.zh: 大元兵至，阿里合力戰不能敵，兵敗被執。

translations.literal: When Great Yuan forces arrived, Alihe fought fiercely but could not prevail; his army was defeated and he was captured.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan forces arrived, Alihe fought fiercely but could not prevail; his army was defeated and he was captured.

sentences.zh: 誘使降，阿里合曰：「吾有死無貳。

translations.literal: They tried to induce him to surrender; Alihe said: 'I have death but no second loyalty.'
translations.idiomatic: They tried to make him surrender. Alihe said: 'I choose death, not disloyalty.'

sentences.zh: 」叱使跪，但向闕而立，於是叢矢射殺之。

translations.literal: They shouted at him to kneel, but he only stood facing the imperial audience hall; thereupon a volley of arrows shot him dead.
translations.idiomatic: They shouted at him to kneel, but he only stood facing the imperial audience hall; a volley of arrows shot him dead.

sentences.zh: 寶昌軍節度副使孔祖湯同時被獲。

translations.literal: Kong Zutang, deputy military commissioner of the Baochang Army, was captured at the same time.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Zutang, deputy military commissioner of the Baochang Army, was captured at the same time.

sentences.zh: 既又令祖湯跪，祖湯不從，亦死。

translations.literal: They then ordered Zutang to kneel; Zutang would not comply and also died.
translations.idiomatic: They then ordered Zutang to kneel; he refused and was killed as well.

sentences.zh: 詔贈阿里合龍虎衛上將軍、泰定軍節度使，祖湯資善大夫、同知平陽府事。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously awarded Alihe General of the Dragon-Tiger Guard and Military Commissioner of the Taiding Army, and Zutang Grand Master of Goodness and Associate Prefect of Pingyang.
translations.idiomatic: Alihe was posthumously made General of the Dragon-Tiger Guard and military commissioner of the Taiding Army; Zutang was made Grand Master of Goodness and associate prefect of Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 祖湯，泰和三年進士。

translations.literal: Zutang was a jinshi graduate in the third year of Taihe.
translations.idiomatic: Zutang passed the jinshi examination in the third year of Taihe.

sentences.zh: 完顏六斤

translations.literal: Wanyan Liujin
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Liujin

sentences.zh: 完顏六斤，中都路胡土愛割蠻猛安人。

translations.literal: Wanyan Liujin was a meng'an of Hutu'aigeli Man on the Zhongdu Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Liujin was registered as a meng'an household of Hutu'aigeli Man on the Zhongdu Circuit.

sentences.zh: 大安中，以廕補官，選充親軍。

translations.literal: During Da'an he entered office by hereditary privilege and was selected to serve in the personal guard.
translations.idiomatic: During Da'an he entered office by hereditary privilege and was selected for the personal guard.

sentences.zh: 調阜平尉，遷方城令，改通州軍事判官，以功遷本州刺史。

translations.literal: He was assigned as bailiff of Fuping, promoted to magistrate of Fangcheng, changed to military judge of Tongzhou, and for merit transferred to prefect of his home prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was posted as bailiff of Fuping, promoted to magistrate of Fangcheng, made military judge of Tongzhou, and for merit became prefect of his home prefecture.

sentences.zh: 頃之，元帥右都監蒲察七斤執之以去。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter Right Army Supervisor of the Marshalate Pucha Qijin seized him and took him away.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Right Army Supervisor Pucha Qijin seized him and took him away.

sentences.zh: 未幾，挈家脫歸，除同知臨洮府事，徙慶陽，遷保大軍節度使。

translations.literal: Before long he brought his family and escaped back; he was appointed associate prefect of Linzhou, moved to Qingyang, and promoted to Military Commissioner of the Baoda Army.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he escaped with his family, was made associate prefect of Linzhou, moved to Qingyang, and was promoted to military commissioner of the Baoda Army.

sentences.zh: 興定五年，鄜州破，六斤自投崖下死焉。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xingding Fuzhou fell; Liujin threw himself from a cliff and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Xingding Fuzhou fell; Liujin threw himself from a cliff and died.

sentences.zh: 贈特進、知延安府事。

translations.literal: He was posthumously awarded Special Advancement and oversight of Yan'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Special Advancement and put in charge of Yan'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 詔陝西行省訪其子孫以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Shaanxi Regional Command to seek out his descendants and report.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Shaanxi Regional Command to seek out his descendants and report.

sentences.zh: 紇石烈鶴壽

translations.literal: Geshilie Heshou
translations.idiomatic: Geshilie Heshou

sentences.zh: 紇石烈鶴壽，河北西路山春猛安人。

translations.literal: Geshilie Heshou was a meng'an of Shanchun on the Hebei West Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Geshilie Heshou was registered as a meng'an household of Shanchun on the Hebei West Circuit.

sentences.zh: 性淳質，軀幹雄偉。

translations.literal: His nature was plain and honest, and his frame was imposing.
translations.idiomatic: He was plain and honest by nature, with an imposing frame.

sentences.zh: 初充親軍。

translations.literal: He first served in the personal guard.
translations.idiomatic: He first served in the personal guard.

sentences.zh: 中泰和三年武舉，調褒信縣副巡檢。

translations.literal: He passed the military examination in the third year of Taihe and was assigned as deputy patrol inspector of Baoxin County.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the military examination in the third year of Taihe and was posted as deputy patrol inspector of Baoxin County.

sentences.zh: 六年，宋人圍蔡州，鶴壽請於防禦使，與勇士五十人夜斫宋營，使諸軍噪於城上，斬三百餘級。

translations.literal: In the sixth year the Song besieged Caizhou; Heshou asked the defense commissioner and, with fifty brave men, raided the Song camp by night, had the various armies raise a clamor on the walls, and beheaded more than three hundred.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the Song besieged Caizhou. Heshou asked the defense commissioner and, with fifty brave men, raided the Song camp by night while the garrison raised a clamor on the walls; they beheaded more than three hundred.

sentences.zh: 宋兵自相蹂踐，死者千余人。

translations.literal: Song troops trampled one another; more than a thousand died.
translations.idiomatic: Song troops trampled one another, and more than a thousand died.

sentences.zh: 遲明，宋人解圍去。

translations.literal: At dawn the Song lifted the siege and departed.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn the Song lifted the siege and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 鶴壽追之，使殿曳柴。

translations.literal: Heshou pursued them, having the rearguard drag brushwood.
translations.idiomatic: Heshou pursued them, with the rearguard dragging brushwood.

sentences.zh: 宋人顧塵起，以為大兵且至，遂奔，追至陳寨而還。

translations.literal: The Song, seeing the dust rise, thought a great army was about to arrive and fled; he pursued to Chen Stockade and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing the dust rise, the Song thought a great army was coming and fled; he pursued to Chen Stockade and returned.

sentences.zh: 已而，宋兵複據新蔡、新息、褒信三縣，鶴壽皆複取之，得馬三百匹，充行軍萬戶，從大軍出壽春，敗宋人於渦口，奪馬千餘匹，攻下真、滁二州及盱眙軍。

translations.literal: Before long the Song again held the three counties of Xincai, Xinxi, and Baoxin; Heshou recovered them all, obtained three hundred horses, served as campaign wanhu, followed the main army out of Shouchun, defeated the Song at Wokou, seized more than a thousand horses, and captured the two prefectures of Zhen and Chu and the Xuyi Army.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Song again held Xincai, Xinxi, and Baoxin; Heshou recovered all three, obtained three hundred horses, served as campaign wanhu, followed the main army from Shouchun, defeated the Song at Wokou, seized more than a thousand horses, and captured Zhen and Chu prefectures and the Xuyi Army.

sentences.zh: 軍還，進九官，遷同知息州軍州事。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he was advanced nine ranks and transferred to associate prefect of Xizhou.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned, he was advanced nine ranks and made associate prefect of Xizhou.

sentences.zh: 改萬甯宮同提舉。

translations.literal: He was changed to concurrent superintendent of the Wannigong.
translations.idiomatic: He was made concurrent superintendent of the Wannigong.

sentences.zh: 大安三年，充西南路馬軍萬戶。

translations.literal: In the third year of Da'an he served as cavalry wanhu on the Southwest Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Da'an he served as cavalry wanhu on the Southwest Circuit.

sentences.zh: 夏人五萬圍東勝，鶴壽救之，突圍入城，夏兵解去。

translations.literal: Fifty thousand Xia besieged Dongsheng; Heshou relieved it, broke through the encirclement into the city, and the Xia withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty thousand Xia besieged Dongsheng; Heshou relieved the city, broke through the encirclement, and the Xia withdrew.

sentences.zh: 遷兩階，賜銀百兩、重彩十端。

translations.literal: He was promoted two ranks and given one hundred taels of silver and ten bolts of heavy brocade.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted two ranks and given one hundred taels of silver and ten bolts of heavy brocade.

sentences.zh: 遷尚方署令，充行軍副統，升充行省左翼都統。

translations.literal: He was transferred to director of the Imperial Workshop Directorate, served as deputy commander of the campaign army, and was promoted to Left Wing Commander-in-Chief of the Regional Command.
translations.idiomatic: He was made director of the Imperial Workshop Directorate, deputy commander of the campaign army, and then Left Wing Commander-in-Chief of the Regional Command.

sentences.zh: 轉武衛軍都統，充馬軍副提控。

translations.literal: He was transferred to commander-in-chief of the Martial Guard Army and served as deputy controller of the cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: He was made commander-in-chief of the Martial Guard Army and deputy controller of the cavalry.

sentences.zh: 轉鈐轄，充都城東面宣差副提控。

translations.literal: He was transferred to commandant and served as deputy imperial commissioner controller on the east side of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: He was made commandant and deputy imperial commissioner controller on the east side of the capital.

sentences.zh: 貞祐二年，丁父憂，起複武寧軍節度副使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenyou he mourned his father's death and returned from leave as deputy military commissioner of the Wuning Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhenyou he mourned his father and was recalled as deputy military commissioner of the Wuning Army.

sentences.zh: 破紅襖賊于蘭陵石城堌，一切掠良人為生口。

translations.literal: He defeated Red-Jacket bandits at the Shicheng Stockade in Lanling and seized all the common people as captives.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated Red-Jacket bandits at the Shicheng Stockade in Lanling and seized all the common people as captives.

sentences.zh: 監察禦史陳規奏：「乞敕有司，凡鶴壽所獲，俱從放免。

translations.literal: Supervising Censor Chen Gui memorialized: 'I beg that the relevant offices be ordered to release all those captured by Heshou.'
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Censor Chen Gui wrote: 'I beg that the authorities release all those captured by Heshou.'

sentences.zh: 」詔徐州、歸德行院拘括放之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Xuzhou and Guixing monasteries to round them up and release them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Xuzhou and Guixing monasteries to round them up and release them.

sentences.zh: 尋遙授同知武甯軍節度使事，兼節度副使。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was remotely commissioned associate military commissioner of the Wuning Army and concurrently deputy military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was given an honorary post as associate military commissioner of the Wuning Army and served concurrently as deputy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 坐出獵縱火延燒官草，杖一百，改同知河平軍節度使事。

translations.literal: For going hunting and setting a fire that spread and burned official fodder, he was beaten one hundred strokes and changed to associate military commissioner of the Heping Army.
translations.idiomatic: For hunting and setting a fire that spread and burned official fodder, he was beaten one hundred strokes and made associate military commissioner of the Heping Army.

sentences.zh: 俄丁母憂，以本官起複，權元帥左都監，行元帥府于鄜州。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he mourned his mother's death; he returned from leave in his former office as acting Left Army Supervisor of the Marshalate and directed the marshalate at Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he mourned his mother; he was recalled in his former office as acting Left Army Supervisor and directed the marshalate at Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 興定五年閏十二月，鄜州破，鶴壽與數騎突出城，追及之，鶴壽據土山力戰而死。

translations.literal: In the intercalary twelfth month of the fifth year of Xingding Fuzhou fell; Heshou broke out of the city with several horsemen; they overtook him; he held a earthen hill and fought fiercely until he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary twelfth month of the fifth year of Xingding Fuzhou fell. Heshou broke out with several horsemen; the enemy overtook him; he held an earthen hill and fought to the death.

sentences.zh: 諡果勇。

translations.literal: His posthumous title was Resolute Courage.
translations.idiomatic: He was given the posthumous title Resolute Courage.

sentences.zh: 蒲察婁室

translations.literal: Pucha Loushi
translations.idiomatic: Pucha Loushi

sentences.zh: 蒲察婁室，東北路按出虎割里罕猛安人。

translations.literal: Pucha Loushi was a meng'an of Aochuhugelihon on the Northeast Route.
translations.idiomatic: Pucha Loushi was registered as a meng'an household of Aochuhugelihon on the Northeast Route.

sentences.zh: 泰和三年進士。

translations.literal: Jinshi graduate in the third year of Taihe.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the third year of Taihe.

sentences.zh: 調慶都、牟平主簿，以廉能遷中都右警巡副使。

translations.literal: He was assigned as chief clerk of Qingdu and Mouping and, for integrity and ability, promoted to deputy patrol commissioner of the Right Capital Watch.
translations.idiomatic: He was posted as chief clerk of Qingdu and Mouping and, for integrity and ability, was made deputy patrol commissioner of the Right Capital Watch.

sentences.zh: 補尚書省令史，知管差除。

translations.literal: He was supplemented as a Secretariat clerical officer in charge of appointments and removals.
translations.idiomatic: He became a Secretariat clerical officer in charge of appointments.

sentences.zh: 貞祐初，除吏部主事、監察禦史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhenyou he was appointed principal clerk in the Ministry of Personnel and supervising censor.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Zhenyou he was made principal clerk in the Ministry of Personnel and supervising censor.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，服闕，充行省經歷官，改京兆治中，遙授定西州刺史，充元帥參議官。

translations.literal: Upon completing mourning for his mother, he served as administrative aide of the Regional Command, was changed to administrative aide of Jingzhao, was remotely commissioned prefect of Dingxi, and served as marshalate deliberation officer.
translations.idiomatic: After his mother's mourning period he served as regional administrative aide, was made Jingzhao administrative aide, given an honorary post as prefect of Dingxi, and served as marshalate deliberation officer.

sentences.zh: 興定二年，與元帥承裔攻下西和州。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xingding, together with Marshal Chengyi, he captured Xihe Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xingding he joined Marshal Chengyi in capturing Xihe Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 白撒由秦州進兵抵棧道，宋人悉銳來拒。

translations.literal: Baisa advanced from Qinzhou to the plank road; the Song brought all their elite troops to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Baisa advanced from Qinzhou to the plank road, and the Song brought all their elite troops to resist.

sentences.zh: 婁室乘高立幟，策馬旋走，揚塵為疑兵，別遣精騎掩出其後，宋兵大潰，乘勝遂拔興元。

translations.literal: Loushi took the heights and raised banners, wheeled his horse in feigned flight, raised dust as a decoy force, and separately sent elite cavalry to strike from behind; the Song army collapsed in great disorder; pressing the advantage they then took Xingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Loushi took the heights and raised banners, wheeled his horse in feigned flight, and raised dust as a decoy while elite cavalry struck from behind; the Song collapsed in disorder, and pressing the advantage they took Xingyuan.

sentences.zh: 進一階，除丹州刺史。

translations.literal: He was advanced one rank and appointed prefect of Danzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was advanced one rank and made prefect of Danzhou.

sentences.zh: 再遷同知河中府事，權元帥右都監、河東路安撫使。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to associate prefect of Hezhong, acting Right Army Supervisor of the Marshalate, and pacification commissioner of the Hedong Route.
translations.idiomatic: He was again made associate prefect of Hezhong, acting Right Army Supervisor, and pacification commissioner of the Hedong Route.

sentences.zh: 複取平陽、晉安，優詔褒寵，進一階，賜銀二百兩、重幣二十端，遙授孟州防禦使，權都監如故。

translations.literal: He again took Pingyang and Jin'an; a special edict praised and rewarded him; he was advanced one rank, given two hundred taels of silver and twenty bolts of heavy cloth, remotely commissioned defense commissioner of Mengzhou, and his acting supervisor post remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: He retook Pingyang and Jin'an; a special edict praised and rewarded him; he was advanced one rank, given two hundred taels of silver and twenty bolts of heavy cloth, made honorary defense commissioner of Mengzhou, and kept his acting supervisor post.

sentences.zh: 將兵救鄜州，轉戰而至，城破死之。

translations.literal: He led troops to relieve Fuzhou, fighting his way there; when the city fell he died.
translations.idiomatic: He led troops to relieve Fuzhou, fighting his way there; when the city fell he was killed.

sentences.zh: 贈資德大夫、定國軍節度使，諡襄勇。

translations.literal: He was posthumously awarded Grand Master of Assisting Virtue and Military Commissioner of the Dingguo Army; his posthumous title was Assisting Courage.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Grand Master of Assisting Virtue and military commissioner of the Dingguo Army, with the posthumous title Assisting Courage.

sentences.zh: 敕行省求其屍以葬。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Regional Command to seek his corpse for burial.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Regional Command to seek his body for burial.

sentences.zh: 女奚烈資祿

translations.literal: Nuxilie Zilu
translations.idiomatic: Nuxilie Zilu

sentences.zh: 女奚烈資祿，本姓張氏，咸平府人。

translations.literal: Nuxilie Zilu, original surname Zhang, was a native of Xianping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Nuxilie Zilu, born Zhang, was from Xianping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 泰和伐宋，從軍有功，調易縣尉，遷潞縣主簿。
