translations.literal: In the Taihe campaign against Song he followed the army with merit, was assigned as bailiff of Yi County, and promoted to chief clerk of Lu County.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taihe campaign against Song he distinguished himself in the army, was posted as bailiff of Yi County, and promoted to chief clerk of Lu County.

sentences.zh: 貞祐初，遙授同知德州防禦事，改秦州。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhenyou he was remotely commissioned associate defense commissioner of Dezhou and transferred to Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Zhenyou he was given an honorary post as associate defense commissioner of Dezhou and transferred to Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 三年，遙授同知通遠軍節度事。

translations.literal: In the third year he was remotely commissioned associate military commissioner of the Tongyuan Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was given an honorary post as associate military commissioner of the Tongyuan Army.

sentences.zh: 興定元年，改西寧州刺史，賜今姓。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xingding he was changed to prefect of Xining and granted his present surname.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xingding he was made prefect of Xining and granted his present surname.

sentences.zh: 久之，遙授同知臨洮府事，兼定西州刺史。

translations.literal: After a long time he was remotely commissioned associate prefect of Linzhou and concurrent prefect of Dingxi.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time he was given an honorary post as associate prefect of Linzhou and served concurrently as prefect of Dingxi.

sentences.zh: 從元帥右都監完顏阿鄰破宋兵於梢子嶺。

translations.literal: Following Right Army Supervisor Wanyan Alin, he defeated Song troops at Shaoziling.
translations.idiomatic: Following Right Army Supervisor Wanyan Alin, he defeated Song troops at Shaoziling.

sentences.zh: 三年，攻破武休關，資祿功最。

translations.literal: In the third year they stormed Wuxiu Pass; Zilu's merit was greatest.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year they stormed Wuxiu Pass; Zilu distinguished himself most.

sentences.zh: 詔比將士遷五官、職二等外，資祿更加官、職一等，遙授通遠軍節度使，刺史如故。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that, in addition to the general officers' five-rank promotion and two-grade advancement in office, Zilu receive one additional rank and grade in office, be remotely commissioned Military Commissioner of the Tongyuan Army, and remain prefect as before.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that, in addition to the general five-rank promotion and two-grade advancement, Zilu receive one additional rank and grade, be made honorary military commissioner of the Tongyuan Army, and remain prefect.

sentences.zh: 五年，遙授隴安軍節度使，俄改金安軍，詔曰：「陝西行省奏軍官闕員。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was remotely commissioned Military Commissioner of the Long'an Army; shortly thereafter he was changed to the Jin'an Army; an edict said: 'The Shaanxi Regional Command reports a shortage of military officers.'
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was made honorary military commissioner of the Long'an Army; soon afterward he was transferred to the Jin'an Army. An edict said: 'The Shaanxi Regional Command reports a shortage of military officers.'

sentences.zh: 卿久在行陣，禦下有法，舊隸士卒多在京兆。

translations.literal: 'You have long been in the ranks and govern subordinates with discipline; many of your former soldiers are in Jingzhao.'
translations.idiomatic: 'You have long served in the field and govern your men with discipline; many of your former soldiers are in Jingzhao.'

sentences.zh: 今正防秋，關、河要衝，悉心備禦。

translations.literal: 'Now is the season for autumn defense; the passes and the Yellow River are vital points—devote yourself fully to preparations.'
translations.idiomatic: 'Autumn defense is at hand; the passes and the Yellow River are vital—prepare with all your care.'

sentences.zh: 」將兵救鄜州。

translations.literal: He led troops to relieve Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He led troops to relieve Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 閏十二月，鄜州破，被執不肯降，遂死。

translations.literal: In the intercalary twelfth month Fuzhou fell; he was captured, would not surrender, and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary twelfth month Fuzhou fell; he was captured, refused to surrender, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 贈銀青榮祿大夫、中京留守。

translations.literal: He was posthumously awarded Silver-Green Grand Master of Glorious Blessings and Garrison Commander of Zhongjing.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Silver-Green Grand Master of Glorious Blessings and Garrison Commander of Zhongjing.

sentences.zh: 元光元年，言事者謂資祿褒贈尚薄，詔錄其二子烈山、林泉，升職一等，陝西行省軍中用之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanguang memorialists said Zilu's posthumous honors were still meager; an edict enrolled his two sons Lieshan and Linquan, advanced them one grade in office, and employed them in the Shaanxi Regional Command army.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yuanguang memorialists said Zilu's posthumous honors were still meager; an edict enrolled his sons Lieshan and Linquan, advanced them one grade, and employed them in the Shaanxi army.

sentences.zh: 侯小叔

translations.literal: Hou Xiaoshu
translations.idiomatic: Hou Xiaoshu

sentences.zh: 侯小叔，河東縣人。

translations.literal: Hou Xiaoshu was a native of Hedong County.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Xiaoshu was from Hedong County.

sentences.zh: 為河津水手。

translations.literal: He was a boatman at Hejin.
translations.idiomatic: He was a boatman at Hejin.

sentences.zh: 貞祐初，籍充鎮威軍，以勞補官。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhenyou he was registered in the Zhenwei Army and entered office for his labors.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Zhenyou he was registered in the Zhenwei Army and entered office for his service.

sentences.zh: 元光元年，遷河中府判官，權河東南路安撫副使。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanguang he was transferred to judge of Hezhong Prefecture and acting deputy pacification commissioner of the Hedong South Route.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yuanguang he was made judge of Hezhong Prefecture and acting deputy pacification commissioner of the Hedong South Route.

sentences.zh: 小叔盡護農民入城，以家財賞戰士。

translations.literal: Xiaoshu brought all the farmers into the city and rewarded the warriors with his household wealth.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaoshu brought all the farmers into the city and rewarded the warriors with his household wealth.

sentences.zh: 河中圍解，遷治中，安撫如故。

translations.literal: When the siege of Hezhong was lifted, he was transferred to administrative aide, his pacification post remaining as before.
translations.idiomatic: When the siege of Hezhong was lifted, he was made administrative aide while keeping his pacification post.

sentences.zh: 樞密院奏：「小叔才能可用，權位輕不足以威眾，乞假符節。

translations.literal: The Bureau of Military Affairs memorialized: 'Xiaoshu's ability can be employed, but his authority is too light to awe the masses; I beg that credentials be lent him.'
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau of Military Affairs wrote: 'Xiaoshu's ability can be used, but his rank is too low to command the troops; lend him credentials.'

sentences.zh: 」十二月，詔權元帥右都監，便宜從事。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month an edict made him acting Right Army Supervisor of the Marshalate with discretionary authority.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he was made acting Right Army Supervisor with discretionary authority.

sentences.zh: 提控吳德說小叔出降，叱出斬之。

translations.literal: Detachment Controller Wu De urged Xiaoshu to surrender; he shouted him out and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Detachment Controller Wu De urged Xiaoshu to surrender; he had him dragged out and beheaded.

sentences.zh: 表兄張先從容言大兵勢重，可出降以保妻子，小叔怒謂先曰：「我舟人子，致身至此，何謂出降。

translations.literal: His cousin Zhang Xian calmly said the great army's strength was overwhelming and he could surrender to preserve his wife and children; Xiaoshu angrily told Xian: 'I am a boatman's son who has raised himself to this point—what talk is there of surrender?'
translations.idiomatic: His cousin Zhang Xian calmly said the great army was overwhelming and he could surrender to save his wife and children. Xiaoshu angrily told Xian: 'I am a boatman's son who has raised himself to this point—what talk is there of surrender?'

sentences.zh: 」縛先於柱而殺之，飯僧祭葬，以盡戚黨之禮。

translations.literal: He bound Xian to a pillar and killed him, fed monks and performed funeral rites, thereby fulfilling the obligations owed to kin.
translations.idiomatic: He bound Xian to a pillar and killed him, then fed monks and performed funeral rites to fulfill his obligations to kin.

sentences.zh: 頃之，樞密院遣都監訛論與小叔議兵事，小叔出城與訛論會，石天應乘之取河中府，作浮橋通陝西。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter the Bureau of Military Affairs sent Supervisor Elun to discuss military affairs with Xiaoshu; Xiaoshu went out of the city to meet Elun; Shi Tianying seized the moment to take Hezhong Prefecture and built a pontoon bridge connecting to Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the Bureau of Military Affairs sent Supervisor Elun to discuss military affairs with Xiaoshu. Xiaoshu went out to meet Elun; Shi Tianying seized the moment to take Hezhong Prefecture and built a pontoon bridge to Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 小叔駐樂李山寨，眾兵畢會，夜半坎城以登，焚樓櫓，火照城中，天應大驚不知所為，盡棄輜重、牌印、馬牛雜畜，死於雙市門。

translations.literal: Xiaoshu encamped at the Leli Mountain Stockade; when all the troops had gathered, at midnight they undermined the wall to climb up, burned the towers and parapets, fire lit the city; Tianying was greatly alarmed and did not know what to do; he abandoned all baggage, seals, horses, cattle, and miscellaneous livestock and died at the Shuangshi Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaoshu encamped at Leli Mountain Stockade. When all his troops had gathered, at midnight they undermined the wall and climbed in, burning the towers; fire lit the city. Tianying was thrown into panic; he abandoned all baggage, seals, horses, and livestock and died at Shuangshi Gate.

sentences.zh: 小叔燒絕浮橋，撫定其眾。

translations.literal: Xiaoshu burned down the pontoon bridge and pacified the troops.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaoshu burned the pontoon bridge and pacified the troops.

sentences.zh: 遷昭毅大將軍，遙授孟州防禦使、同知府事，監軍、安撫如故。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Great General of Martial Resolution, remotely commissioned Defense Commissioner of Mengzhou and concurrent prefect, his army supervisor and pacification posts remaining as before.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Great General of Martial Resolution, given an honorary post as defense commissioner of Mengzhou and concurrent prefect, while keeping his supervisor and pacification posts.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，大元軍騎十萬圍河中，總師訛可遣提控孫昌率兵五千，樞密副使完顏賽不遣李仁智率兵三千，俱救河中。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year, one hundred thousand Great Yuan cavalry besieged Hezhong; Commander-in-Chief Eke sent Detachment Controller Sun Chang with five thousand troops, and Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Wanyan Saibu sent Li Renzhi with three thousand troops, all to relieve Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year, one hundred thousand Yuan cavalry besieged Hezhong. Commander-in-Chief Eke sent Detachment Controller Sun Chang with five thousand men, and Vice Director Wanyan Saibu sent Li Renzhi with three thousand, all to relieve the city.

sentences.zh: 小叔期以夜中鳴鉦，內外相應。

translations.literal: Xiaoshu arranged to strike the gong at midnight so that inside and outside would respond together.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaoshu arranged to strike the gong at midnight so the city and relief force could act together.

sentences.zh: 及期，小叔出兵戰，昌、仁智不敢動。

translations.literal: When the time came, Xiaoshu led troops out to fight, but Chang and Renzhi did not dare move.
translations.idiomatic: When the time came, Xiaoshu led troops out to fight, but Chang and Renzhi did not move.

sentences.zh: 小叔斂眾入城，圍益急，眾議出保山寨，小叔曰：「去何之？

translations.literal: Xiaoshu gathered his forces back into the city; the siege grew tighter; the crowd discussed fleeing to protect the mountain stockade; Xiaoshu said: 'Where would we go?'
translations.idiomatic: Xiaoshu gathered his forces back into the city. The siege tightened, and some proposed fleeing to the mountain stockade. Xiaoshu said: 'Where would we go?'

sentences.zh: 」密遣經歷官張思祖潰圍出，奔告於汴京。

translations.literal: He secretly sent Administrative Aide Zhang Sizu to break out of the encirclement and rush to report at Bianjing.
translations.idiomatic: He secretly sent Administrative Aide Zhang Sizu to break out and rush to report at Bianjing.

sentences.zh: 明日，城破，小叔死，不得其屍。

translations.literal: The next day the city fell; Xiaoshu died, and his corpse could not be found.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the city fell; Xiaoshu died, and his body could not be found.

sentences.zh: 總帥訛可以河中府推官籍阿外代小叔權右都監。

translations.literal: Commander-in-Chief Eke had Hezhong Prefecture judicial officer Ji A'wai replace Xiaoshu as acting Right Army Supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: Commander-in-Chief Eke had Hezhong judicial officer Ji A'wai replace Xiaoshu as acting Right Army Supervisor.

sentences.zh: 樞密院奏：「小叔功卓異，或疑尚在，遽令阿外代之，絕歸向之路。

translations.literal: The Bureau of Military Affairs memorialized: 'Xiaoshu's achievements were outstanding; some suspect he may still be alive; to have A'wai replace him so hastily cuts off the path of return.'
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau of Military Affairs wrote: 'Xiaoshu's achievements were outstanding; some suspect he may still be alive; replacing him so hastily cuts off any path of return.'

sentences.zh: 」至是，小叔已亡四十餘日，中條諸寨無所統領，乃詔阿外權領。

translations.literal: By this time Xiaoshu had been dead more than forty days; the stockades of the Zhongtiao range had no leader, and an edict then ordered A'wai to lead them provisionally.
translations.idiomatic: By then Xiaoshu had been dead more than forty days; the Zhongtiao stockades had no leader, and an edict ordered A'wai to lead them provisionally.

sentences.zh: 宣宗思小叔功，下詔褒贈，切責訛可不救河中之罪。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong, mindful of Xiaoshu's achievements, issued an edict praising and rewarding him posthumously and sternly blamed Eke for the crime of not relieving Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: Mindful of Xiaoshu's achievements, Xuanzong issued an edict praising and rewarding him posthumously and sternly blamed Eke for failing to relieve Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 王佐，字輔之，霍州農家子。

translations.literal: Wang Zuo, style name Fuzhi, was a farmer's son of Huozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zuo, style name Fuzhi, was a farmer's son from Huozhou.

sentences.zh: 豁略不事產業，輕財好施，善騎射。

translations.literal: He was broad and unconcerned with managing property, light with wealth and fond of giving, and skilled at mounted archery.
translations.idiomatic: He cared little for managing property, was generous with wealth, and was skilled at mounted archery.

sentences.zh: 興定中，聚兵數千人，權領霍州事。

translations.literal: During Xingding he gathered several thousand troops and provisionally directed the affairs of Huozhou.
translations.idiomatic: During Xingding he gathered several thousand troops and provisionally directed affairs at Huozhou.

sentences.zh: 平陽胡天作承制加忠勇校尉、趙城丞，遷霍邑令、同知蒲州軍事，權招撫副使、蒲州經略使。

translations.literal: Hu Tianzuo of Pingyang, by imperial order, added the rank of Loyal and Brave Company Commander and made magistrate of Zhaocheng; he was transferred to magistrate of Huoyi, associate military affairs of Puzhou, acting deputy pacification commissioner, and frontier commissioner of Puzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Tianzuo of Pingyang was by imperial order made Loyal and Brave Company Commander and magistrate of Zhaocheng, then magistrate of Huoyi, associate military affairs of Puzhou, acting deputy pacification commissioner, and frontier commissioner of Puzhou.

sentences.zh: 詔遷宣武將軍，遙授寶昌軍節度副使。

translations.literal: An edict transferred him to General of Martial Proclamation and remotely commissioned him deputy military commissioner of the Baochang Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to General of Martial Proclamation and given an honorary post as deputy military commissioner of the Baochang Army.

sentences.zh: 大元兵取青龍堡，佐被獲，署霍州守將，隸元帥崔環，質其妻子。

translations.literal: When Great Yuan forces took Qinglong Fort, Zuo was captured, appointed garrison commander of Huozhou, placed under Marshal Cui Huan, and his wife and children were held as hostages.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan forces took Qinglong Fort, Zuo was captured, appointed garrison commander of Huozhou, placed under Marshal Cui Huan, and his wife and children were held as hostages.

sentences.zh: 招撫使成天祐與環有隙，佐與天祐謀殺環，天祐曰：「君妻子為質奈何？

translations.literal: Pacification Commissioner Cheng Tianyou had a rift with Huan; Zuo plotted with Tianyou to kill Huan; Tianyou said: 'Your wife and children are hostages—what then?'
translations.idiomatic: Pacification Commissioner Cheng Tianyou had a feud with Huan. Zuo plotted with Tianyou to kill Huan. Tianyou said: 'Your wife and children are hostages—what then?'

sentences.zh: 」佐曰：「佐豈顧家者邪？

translations.literal: Zuo said: 'Would Zuo be one who cares for his household?'
translations.idiomatic: Zuo said: 'Would I be one who cares for his household?'

sentences.zh: 」元光二年七月，因環出獵殺之，率軍民數萬請命，加龍虎衛上將軍、元帥右監軍、兼知平陽府事。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year of Yuanguang, when Huan went hunting he killed him, led several tens of thousands of soldiers and civilians to submit, and was given the ranks of General of the Dragon-Tiger Guard, Right Army Supervisor of the Marshalate, and concurrent oversight of Pingyang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the second year of Yuanguang, when Huan went hunting he killed him, led tens of thousands of soldiers and civilians to submit, and was made General of the Dragon-Tiger Guard, Right Army Supervisor, and put in charge of Pingyang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 佐與平陽公史詠素不協，請徙沁州玉女寨，詔從之，仍令聽上党公完顏開節制。

translations.literal: Zuo had long been at odds with Duke Shi Yong of Pingyang; he asked to be moved to the Jade Maiden Stockade in Qinzhou; an edict approved this and still ordered him to obey the command of Duke Wanyan Kai of Shangdang.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo had long been at odds with Duke Shi Yong of Pingyang. He asked to be moved to the Jade Maiden Stockade in Qinzhou; the emperor approved and ordered him to obey Duke Wanyan Kai of Shangdang.

sentences.zh: 是歲七月，救襄垣，中流矢卒。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of that year, while relieving Xiangyuan, he was struck by a stray arrow and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of that year, while relieving Xiangyuan, he was struck by an arrow and died.

sentences.zh: 贈金吾衛上將軍，以其子為符寶典書。

translations.literal: He was posthumously awarded General of the Golden Crow Guard, and his son was made Director of Seals and Treasures.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made General of the Golden Crow Guard, and his son was appointed Director of Seals and Treasures.

sentences.zh: 黃摑九住

translations.literal: Huangguai Jiuzhu
translations.idiomatic: Huangguai Jiuzhu

sentences.zh: 黃摑九住，臨潢人。

translations.literal: Huangguai Jiuzhu was a native of Linhuang.
translations.idiomatic: Huangguai Jiuzhu was from Linhuang.

sentences.zh: 大定間，以廕補部令史，轉樞密院令史，調安肅州軍事判官。

translations.literal: During Dading he entered office by hereditary privilege as a ministry clerical officer, transferred to a clerical officer of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and was assigned as military judge of Ansu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: During Dading he entered office by hereditary privilege as a ministry clerk, became a clerk in the Bureau of Military Affairs, and was posted as military judge of Ansu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 明昌四年，為大理執法，同知薊州軍事，再遷潞王府司馬，累官河東北路按察使、轉運使，改知彰德府事。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Mingchang he served as law enforcement officer of the Court of Review, associate military affairs of Jizhou, was again transferred to marshal of the Prince of Lu's household, and through successive offices became surveillance commissioner and transport commissioner of the Hedong North Route and was changed to prefect of Zhangde.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Mingchang he served as law enforcement officer of the Court of Review, associate military affairs of Jizhou, marshal of the Prince of Lu's household, and rose to surveillance commissioner and transport commissioner of the Hedong North Route before becoming prefect of Zhangde.

sentences.zh: 戰歿。

translations.literal: He died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: He died in battle.

sentences.zh: 贈榮祿大夫、南京留守，仍錄用其子孫。

translations.literal: He was posthumously awarded Grand Master of Glorious Blessings and Garrison Commander of Nanjing, and his descendants were still enrolled for appointment.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Grand Master of Glorious Blessings and Garrison Commander of Nanjing, and his descendants were enrolled for appointment.

sentences.zh: 烏林答乞住

translations.literal: Wulinda Qizhu
translations.idiomatic: Wulinda Qizhu

sentences.zh: 烏林答乞住，大名路猛安人。

translations.literal: Wulinda Qizhu was a meng'an of the Daming Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Wulinda Qizhu was registered as a meng'an household on the Daming Circuit.

sentences.zh: 大定二十八年進士。

translations.literal: Jinshi graduate in the twenty-eighth year of Dading.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the twenty-eighth year of Dading.

sentences.zh: 累官補尚書省令史，除山東提刑判官、英王府司馬。

translations.literal: Through successive offices he was supplemented as a Secretariat clerical officer, appointed judicial commissioner of Shandong, and marshal of the Prince of Ying's household.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Secretariat clerical officer, judicial commissioner of Shandong, and marshal of the Prince of Ying's household.

sentences.zh: 禦史台舉前在山東稱職，改太原府治中。

translations.literal: The Censorate recommended him for having performed capably earlier in Shandong, and he was changed to administrative aide of Taiyuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate recommended him for capable service in Shandong, and he was made administrative aide of Taiyuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 簽陝西按察司事，曆汝州、沁州刺史，北京、臨潢按察副使，遷蒲與路節度使。

translations.literal: He signed documents for the Shaanxi Surveillance Commission, served successively as prefect of Ruzhou and Qinzhou, as deputy surveillance commissioner of Beijing and Linhuang, and was transferred to Military Commissioner of the Puyu Route.
translations.idiomatic: He served in the Shaanxi Surveillance Commission, was prefect of Ruzhou and Qinzhou, deputy surveillance commissioner of Beijing and Linhuang, and was made military commissioner of the Puyu Route.

sentences.zh: 未幾，以罪奪三官，解職，降德昌軍節度副使。

translations.literal: Before long, for a crime three ranks were stripped from him, he was removed from office, and demoted to deputy military commissioner of the Dechang Army.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was stripped of three ranks for a crime, removed from office, and demoted to deputy military commissioner of the Dechang Army.

sentences.zh: 崇慶初，戍邊有功，遷一官，賞銀百兩、重幣十端，轉利州刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chongqing he rendered merit on the frontier garrison, was advanced one rank, rewarded with one hundred taels of silver and ten bolts of heavy cloth, and transferred to prefect of Lizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Chongqing he distinguished himself on the frontier, was advanced one rank, rewarded with one hundred taels of silver and ten bolts of heavy cloth, and made prefect of Lizhou.

sentences.zh: 貞祐初，改同知咸平府事，遷歸德軍節度使，改興平軍，就充東面經略使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhenyou he was changed to associate prefect of Xianping, transferred to Military Commissioner of the Guide Army, changed to the Xingping Army, and then served as Eastern Frontier Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Zhenyou he was made associate prefect of Xianping, military commissioner of the Guide Army, then of the Xingping Army, and served as Eastern Frontier Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 尋罷經略司，改元帥右都監。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter the frontier commission was abolished and he was changed to Right Army Supervisor of the Marshalate.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the frontier commission was abolished and he was made Right Army Supervisor of the Marshalate.

sentences.zh: 赴援中都戰歿。

translations.literal: He went to relieve Zhongdu and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: He went to relieve Zhongdu and died in battle.

sentences.zh: 贈榮祿大夫、參知政事，以參政半俸給其家。

translations.literal: He was posthumously awarded Grand Master of Glorious Blessings and Councilor, and half a councilor's salary was given to his household.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Grand Master of Glorious Blessings and Councilor, and half a councilor's salary was given to his family.

sentences.zh: 陀滿斜烈

translations.literal: Tuoman Xielie
translations.idiomatic: Tuoman Xielie

sentences.zh: 陀滿斜烈，咸平路猛安人。

translations.literal: Tuoman Xielie was a meng'an of the Xianping Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Tuoman Xielie was registered as a meng'an household on the Xianping Circuit.

sentences.zh: 襲父猛安。

translations.literal: He inherited his father's meng'an status.
translations.idiomatic: He inherited his father's meng'an status.

sentences.zh: 明昌中，以所部兵充押軍萬戶，戍邊。

translations.literal: During Mingchang he served with his own troops as escort-army wanhu on the frontier garrison.
translations.idiomatic: During Mingchang he served with his own troops as escort-army wanhu on the frontier.

sentences.zh: 承安中，討契丹有功，除陳州防禦使。

translations.literal: During Chengan he rendered merit in campaigning against the Khitan and was appointed defense commissioner of Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: During Chengan he distinguished himself campaigning against the Khitan and was made defense commissioner of Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 遷知平涼府事，改保大軍節度使，徙知彰德府事。

translations.literal: He was transferred to prefect of Pingliang, changed to Military Commissioner of the Baoda Army, and moved to prefect of Zhangde.
translations.idiomatic: He was made prefect of Pingliang, military commissioner of the Baoda Army, and then prefect of Zhangde.

sentences.zh: 貞祐四年，大元兵複取彰德，斜烈死焉。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhenyou Great Yuan forces again took Zhangde, and Xielie died there.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Zhenyou Yuan forces again took Zhangde, and Xielie died there.

sentences.zh: 尼厖古蒲魯虎

translations.literal: Nilanggupuluhu
translations.idiomatic: Nilanggupuluhu

sentences.zh: 尼厖古蒲魯虎，中都路猛安人。

translations.literal: Nilanggupuluhu was a meng'an of the Zhongdu Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Nilanggupuluhu was registered as a meng'an household on the Zhongdu Circuit.

sentences.zh: 明昌五年進士。

translations.literal: Jinshi graduate in the fifth year of Mingchang.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the fifth year of Mingchang.

sentences.zh: 累官補尚書省令史，從平章政事僕散揆伐宋。

translations.literal: Through successive offices he was supplemented as a Secretariat clerical officer and followed Grand Councilor Pusan Kui in the campaign against Song.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Secretariat clerical officer and followed Grand Councilor Pusan Kui in the campaign against Song.

sentences.zh: 兵罷，除同知崇義軍節度使事。

translations.literal: When the campaign ended he was appointed associate military commissioner of the Chongyi Army.
translations.idiomatic: When the campaign ended he was made associate military commissioner of the Chongyi Army.

sentences.zh: 察廉，改東平府治中。

translations.literal: Selected for integrity, he was changed to administrative aide of Dongping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Selected for integrity, he was made administrative aide of Dongping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 曆環州、裕州刺史，翰林待制，開封府治中，大理卿。

translations.literal: He served successively as prefect of Huanzhou and Yuzhou, Hanlin Academician-in-Waiting, administrative aide of Kaifeng Prefecture, and chief justice of the Court of Review.
translations.idiomatic: He served as prefect of Huanzhou and Yuzhou, Hanlin Academician-in-Waiting, administrative aide of Kaifeng Prefecture, and chief justice of the Court of Review.

sentences.zh: 尋擢知河南府事，兼河南路副統軍。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was promoted to prefect of Henan and concurrent deputy commander-in-chief of the Henan Route.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was made prefect of Henan and deputy commander-in-chief of the Henan Route.

sentences.zh: 貞祐四年，急備京西，為陝州宣撫副使、兼西安軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhenyou, with urgent preparations west of the capital, he became deputy pacification commissioner of Shaanzhou and concurrent Military Commissioner of the Xi'an Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Zhenyou, with urgent preparations west of the capital, he was made deputy pacification commissioner of Shaanzhou and military commissioner of the Xi'an Army.

sentences.zh: 是歲，大元兵取潼關，戍卒皆潰，蒲魯虎禦戰，兵敗死焉。

translations.literal: That year Great Yuan forces took Tongguan; the garrison troops all collapsed; Puluhu fought in defense, his army was defeated, and he died.
translations.idiomatic: That year Yuan forces took Tongguan; the garrison collapsed; Puluhu fought in defense, was defeated, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 兀顏畏可

translations.literal: Wuyan Weike
translations.idiomatic: Wuyan Weike

sentences.zh: 兀顏畏可，隆安路猛安人。

translations.literal: Wuyan Weike was a meng'an of the Long'an Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Wuyan Weike was registered as a meng'an household on the Long'an Circuit.

sentences.zh: 補親軍，充護衛，除益都總管府判官、中都兵馬副都指揮使，累官會州刺史。

translations.literal: He was supplemented in the personal guard, served in the imperial guard, was appointed judge of the Yidu Commandery headquarters, deputy commander of capital troops and horses, and through successive offices became prefect of Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He served in the personal guard and imperial guard, was judge of the Yidu Commandery headquarters, deputy commander of capital troops and horses, and rose to prefect of Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 貞祐初，為左衛將軍、拱衛直都指揮使、山東副統軍、安化軍節度使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhenyou he served as General of the Left Guard, commander of the Arch-Guard Direct Command, deputy commander-in-chief of Shandong, and Military Commissioner of the Anhua Army.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Zhenyou he was General of the Left Guard, commander of the Arch-Guard Direct Command, deputy commander-in-chief of Shandong, and military commissioner of the Anhua Army.

sentences.zh: 土賊據九仙山為巢穴，畏可擁眾不擊，賊愈熾。

translations.literal: Local bandits held the Jiuxian Mountains as their lair; Weike held his troops back and did not attack, and the bandits grew ever fiercer.
translations.idiomatic: Local bandits held the Jiuxian Mountains as their lair. Weike held his troops back and did not attack, and the bandits grew fiercer.

sentences.zh: 東平行省蒙古綱劾奏畏可不任將帥，朝廷不問。

translations.literal: Mongol Gang of the Dongping Regional Command impeached Weike as unfit for command; the court did not inquire.
translations.idiomatic: Mongol Gang of the Dongping Regional Command impeached Weike as unfit for command; the court took no action.

sentences.zh: 改鎮西軍，權經略副使，曆金安、武勝軍。

translations.literal: He was changed to the Zhenxi Army, acting deputy frontier commissioner, and served successively in the Jin'an and Wusheng armies.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Zhenxi Army as acting deputy frontier commissioner and served in the Jin'an and Wusheng armies.

sentences.zh: 興定四年，改泰定軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xingding he was changed to the Taiding Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Xingding he was transferred to the Taiding Army.

sentences.zh: 是歲五月，袞州破，死焉。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of that year Yanzhou fell, and he died there.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of that year Yanzhou fell, and he died there.

sentences.zh: 兀顏訛出虎

translations.literal: Wuyan Echuhu
translations.idiomatic: Wuyan Echuhu

sentences.zh: 兀顏訛出虎，隆安府猛安人。

translations.literal: Wuyan Echuhu was a meng'an of Long'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wuyan Echuhu was registered as a meng'an household of Long'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 大定二十八年進士。

translations.literal: Jinshi graduate in the twenty-eighth year of Dading.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the twenty-eighth year of Dading.

sentences.zh: 累官補尚書省令史，除順天軍節度副使，召為治書侍御史、刑部員外郎、單州刺史、戶部郎中、河東北路按察副使、同知大興府事、秦州防禦使。

translations.literal: Through successive offices he was supplemented as a Secretariat clerical officer, appointed deputy military commissioner of the Shuntian Army, summoned as Supervising Secretary and Attending Censor, vice director in the Ministry of Justice, prefect of Shanzhou, director in the Ministry of Revenue, deputy surveillance commissioner of the Hedong North Route, associate prefect of Daxing, and defense commissioner of Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Secretariat clerical officer, deputy military commissioner of the Shuntian Army, Supervising Secretary and Attending Censor, vice director in the Ministry of Justice, prefect of Shanzhou, director in the Ministry of Revenue, deputy surveillance commissioner of the Hedong North Route, associate prefect of Daxing, and defense commissioner of Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，起複泗州防禦使，遷武甯軍節度使，徙河平軍、兼都水監。

translations.literal: Upon mourning his mother's death he returned from leave as defense commissioner of Sizhou, was transferred to Military Commissioner of the Wuning Army, moved to the Heping Army, and served concurrently as director of waterways.
translations.idiomatic: After his mother's mourning he was recalled as defense commissioner of Sizhou, made military commissioner of the Wuning Army, transferred to the Heping Army, and served concurrently as director of waterways.

sentences.zh: 坐前在武甯奏軍功不實，降沂州防禦使，遷汾陽軍節度使、兼經略使。

translations.literal: For having earlier at Wuning reported military achievements falsely, he was demoted to defense commissioner of Yizhou and transferred to Military Commissioner of the Fenyang Army and concurrent frontier commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: For having falsely reported military achievements at Wuning, he was demoted to defense commissioner of Yizhou and made military commissioner of the Fenyang Army and frontier commissioner.

sentences.zh: 興定二年九月，城破死焉。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the second year of Xingding the city fell and he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the second year of Xingding the city fell and he was killed.
